import Mathlib
open Real
open Set

set_option maxHeartbeats 800000

namespace Submission

lemma hasDerivAt_sin_mul (ω x : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun x' : ℝ => sin (ω * x')) (ω * cos (ω * x)) x := by
  have h : HasDerivAt (fun x' : ℝ => ω * x') ω x := by
    simpa using (HasDerivAt.const_mul ω (hasDerivAt_id x))
  simpa [mul_comm] using h.sin

lemma hasDerivAt_cos_mul (ω x : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun x' : ℝ => cos (ω * x')) (-ω * sin (ω * x)) x := by
  have h : HasDerivAt (fun x' : ℝ => ω * x') ω x := by
    simpa using (HasDerivAt.const_mul ω (hasDerivAt_id x))
  have hcos := (Real.hasDerivAt_cos (ω * x)).comp x h
  simpa [mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using hcos

lemma aux_deriv_F (y : ℝ → ℝ) (lam ω : ℝ) (hωsq : ω^2 = lam) (hωpos : ω > 0) (x : ℝ) 
    (hx_deriv_y : HasDerivAt y (deriv y x) x)
    (hx_deriv_deriv : HasDerivAt (deriv y) (-(lam * y x)) x) : 
    HasDerivAt (fun x' : ℝ => y x' * sin (ω * x') + (deriv y x' / ω) * cos (ω * x')) 0 x := by
  have h_ysin : HasDerivAt (fun x' : ℝ => y x' * sin (ω * x')) 
      ((deriv y x) * sin (ω * x) + y x * (ω * cos (ω * x))) x :=
    HasDerivAt.mul hx_deriv_y (hasDerivAt_sin_mul ω x)
  have h_term2 : HasDerivAt (fun x' : ℝ => (deriv y x' / ω) * cos (ω * x')) 
      (-(lam * y x) / ω * cos (ω * x) + (deriv y x / ω) * (-ω * sin (ω * x))) x := by
    have h_deriv_div : HasDerivAt (fun x' : ℝ => deriv y x' / ω) (-(lam * y x) / ω) x := by
      simpa [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm] using (HasDerivAt.const_mul (1/ω) hx_deriv_deriv)
    have h_cos := hasDerivAt_cos_mul ω x
    exact HasDerivAt.mul h_deriv_div h_cos
  have h_total : HasDerivAt (fun x' : ℝ => y x' * sin (ω * x') + (deriv y x' / ω) * cos (ω * x'))
      (((deriv y x) * sin (ω * x) + y x * (ω * cos (ω * x))) + 
       (-(lam * y x) / ω * cos (ω * x) + (deriv y x / ω) * (-ω * sin (ω * x)))) x :=
    HasDerivAt.add h_ysin h_term2
  have hω_ne : ω ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have h_sin_zero : (deriv y x) * sin (ω * x) + (deriv y x / ω) * (-ω * sin (ω * x)) = 0 := by
    field_simp [hω_ne]; ring
  have h_cos_zero : y x * (ω * cos (ω * x)) + (-(lam * y x) / ω) * cos (ω * x) = 0 := by
    calc
      y x * (ω * cos (ω * x)) + (-(lam * y x) / ω) * cos (ω * x)
          = y x * cos (ω * x) * (ω - lam / ω) := by ring
      _ = y x * cos (ω * x) * (ω - ω^2 / ω) := by rw [hωsq]
      _ = y x * cos (ω * x) * (ω - ω) := by field_simp [hω_ne]
      _ = y x * cos (ω * x) * 0 := by ring
      _ = 0 := by ring
  have h_simplify : ((deriv y x) * sin (ω * x) + y x * (ω * cos (ω * x))) + 
    (-(lam * y x) / ω * cos (ω * x) + (deriv y x / ω) * (-ω * sin (ω * x))) = 0 := by
    calc
      ((deriv y x) * sin (ω * x) + y x * (ω * cos (ω * x))) + 
      (-(lam * y x) / ω * cos (ω * x) + (deriv y x / ω) * (-ω * sin (ω * x)))
          = ((deriv y x) * sin (ω * x) + (deriv y x / ω) * (-ω * sin (ω * x))) +
            (y x * (ω * cos (ω * x)) + (-(lam * y x) / ω) * cos (ω * x)) := by ring
      _ = 0 + 0 := by rw [h_sin_zero, h_cos_zero]
      _ = 0 := by simp
  have h_total' : HasDerivAt (fun x' : ℝ => y x' * sin (ω * x') + (deriv y x' / ω) * cos (ω * x'))
      (((deriv y x) * sin (ω * x) + y x * (ω * cos (ω * x))) + 
       (-(lam * y x) / ω * cos (ω * x) + -(deriv y x / ω * (ω * sin (ω * x))))) x := by
    have h_eq : ((deriv y x) * sin (ω * x) + y x * (ω * cos (ω * x))) + 
      (-(lam * y x) / ω * cos (ω * x) + (deriv y x / ω) * (-ω * sin (ω * x))) =
      ((deriv y x) * sin (ω * x) + y x * (ω * cos (ω * x))) + 
      (-(lam * y x) / ω * cos (ω * x) + -(deriv y x / ω * (ω * sin (ω * x)))) := by ring
    simpa [h_eq] using h_total
  have h_simplify' : ((deriv y x) * sin (ω * x) + y x * (ω * cos (ω * x))) + 
    (-(lam * y x) / ω * cos (ω * x) + -(deriv y x / ω * (ω * sin (ω * x)))) = 0 := by
    calc
      ((deriv y x) * sin (ω * x) + y x * (ω * cos (ω * x))) + 
      (-(lam * y x) / ω * cos (ω * x) + -(deriv y x / ω * (ω * sin (ω * x))))
          = ((deriv y x) * sin (ω * x) + y x * (ω * cos (ω * x))) + 
            (-(lam * y x) / ω * cos (ω * x) + (deriv y x / ω) * (-ω * sin (ω * x))) := by ring
      _ = 0 := h_simplify
  simpa [h_simplify'] using h_total'

lemma aux_deriv_G (y : ℝ → ℝ) (lam ω : ℝ) (hωsq : ω^2 = lam) (hωpos : ω > 0) (x : ℝ) 
    (hx_deriv_y : HasDerivAt y (deriv y x) x)
    (hx_deriv_deriv : HasDerivAt (deriv y) (-(lam * y x)) x) : 
    HasDerivAt (fun x' : ℝ => y x' * cos (ω * x') - (deriv y x' / ω) * sin (ω * x')) 0 x := by
  have h_ycos : HasDerivAt (fun x' : ℝ => y x' * cos (ω * x')) 
      ((deriv y x) * cos (ω * x) + y x * (-ω * sin (ω * x))) x :=
    HasDerivAt.mul hx_deriv_y (hasDerivAt_cos_mul ω x)
  have h_term2 : HasDerivAt (fun x' : ℝ => (deriv y x' / ω) * sin (ω * x')) 
      (-(lam * y x) / ω * sin (ω * x) + (deriv y x / ω) * (ω * cos (ω * x))) x := by
    have h_deriv_div : HasDerivAt (fun x' : ℝ => deriv y x' / ω) (-(lam * y x) / ω) x := by
      simpa [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm] using (HasDerivAt.const_mul (1/ω) hx_deriv_deriv)
    have h_sin := hasDerivAt_sin_mul ω x
    exact HasDerivAt.mul h_deriv_div h_sin
  have h_sub_raw : HasDerivAt (fun x' : ℝ => y x' * cos (ω * x') - (deriv y x' / ω) * sin (ω * x'))
      (((deriv y x) * cos (ω * x) + y x * (-ω * sin (ω * x))) - 
       (-(lam * y x) / ω * sin (ω * x) + (deriv y x / ω) * (ω * cos (ω * x)))) x :=
    HasDerivAt.sub h_ycos h_term2
  have hω_ne : ω ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have h_simplify : ((deriv y x) * cos (ω * x) + y x * (-ω * sin (ω * x))) - 
    (-(lam * y x) / ω * sin (ω * x) + (deriv y x / ω) * (ω * cos (ω * x))) = 0 := by
    calc
      ((deriv y x) * cos (ω * x) + y x * (-ω * sin (ω * x))) - 
      (-(lam * y x) / ω * sin (ω * x) + (deriv y x / ω) * (ω * cos (ω * x)))
          = (deriv y x) * cos (ω * x) - (deriv y x / ω) * (ω * cos (ω * x)) +
            y x * (-ω * sin (ω * x)) + (lam * y x / ω) * sin (ω * x) := by ring
      _ = ((deriv y x) * cos (ω * x) - (deriv y x) * cos (ω * x)) +
            y x * sin (ω * x) * (-ω + lam / ω) := by
              field_simp [hω_ne]; ring
      _ = 0 + y x * sin (ω * x) * (-ω + lam / ω) := by ring
      _ = y x * sin (ω * x) * (-ω + lam / ω) := by simp
      _ = y x * sin (ω * x) * (-ω + ω^2 / ω) := by rw [hωsq]
      _ = y x * sin (ω * x) * (-ω + ω) := by field_simp [hω_ne]
      _ = y x * sin (ω * x) * 0 := by ring
      _ = 0 := by ring
  have h_sub_deriv_eq : ((deriv y x) * cos (ω * x) + y x * (-ω * sin (ω * x))) - 
    (-(lam * y x) / ω * sin (ω * x) + (deriv y x / ω) * (ω * cos (ω * x))) = 
    (deriv y x) * cos (ω * x) + -(y x * (ω * sin (ω * x))) -
    (-(lam * y x) / ω * sin (ω * x) + (deriv y x / ω) * (ω * cos (ω * x))) := by ring
  have h_simplify' : (deriv y x) * cos (ω * x) + -(y x * (ω * sin (ω * x))) -
    (-(lam * y x) / ω * sin (ω * x) + (deriv y x / ω) * (ω * cos (ω * x))) = 0 := by
    rw [← h_sub_deriv_eq, h_simplify]
  simpa [h_simplify'] using h_sub_raw

theorem dirichlet_eigenvalues_eq_nat_sq (lam : ℝ) :
    (∃ (y : ℝ → ℝ) (J : Set ℝ),
        IsOpen J ∧ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) Real.pi ⊆ J ∧
        (∀ x ∈ J, HasDerivAt y (deriv y x) x) ∧
        (∀ x ∈ J, HasDerivAt (deriv y) (-(lam * y x)) x) ∧
        y 0 = 0 ∧ y Real.pi = 0 ∧
        ∃ x ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) Real.pi, y x ≠ 0) ↔
      ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ lam = (n : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases h with ⟨y, J, hJopen, hJsub, hy, hy', hy0, hypi, hnonz⟩
    rcases hnonz with ⟨x0, hx0mem, hx0nonz⟩
    have h0J : (0 : ℝ) ∈ J := hJsub (Set.left_mem_Icc.mpr (by nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]))
    have hpiJ : Real.pi ∈ J := hJsub (Set.right_mem_Icc.mpr (by nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]))
    have hx0J : x0 ∈ J := hJsub (Set.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hx0mem.1.le, hx0mem.2.le⟩)
    have hx0Icc : x0 ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) Real.pi := Set.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hx0mem.1.le, hx0mem.2.le⟩
    
    by_cases hlam_pos : lam > 0
    · set ω := Real.sqrt lam with hω
      have hωpos : ω > 0 := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hlam_pos
      have hωsq : ω^2 = lam := Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith)
      
      set C := connectedComponentIn J 0 with hC
      have hCopen : IsOpen C := IsOpen.connectedComponentIn (F := J) (x := 0) hJopen
      have hCpre : IsPreconnected C := isPreconnected_connectedComponentIn
      have h0C : (0 : ℝ) ∈ C := mem_connectedComponentIn h0J
      have hpiC : Real.pi ∈ C := by
        have hpre_Icc : IsPreconnected (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) Real.pi) := isPreconnected_Icc
        have hsubset : Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) Real.pi ⊆ C :=
          hpre_Icc.subset_connectedComponentIn (Set.left_mem_Icc.mpr (by nlinarith [Real.pi_pos])) hJsub
        exact hsubset (Set.right_mem_Icc.mpr (by nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]))
      have hx0C : x0 ∈ C := by
        have hpre_Icc : IsPreconnected (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) Real.pi) := isPreconnected_Icc
        have hsubset : Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) Real.pi ⊆ C :=
          hpre_Icc.subset_connectedComponentIn (Set.left_mem_Icc.mpr (by nlinarith [Real.pi_pos])) hJsub
        exact hsubset hx0Icc
      
      let F : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => y x * sin (ω * x) + (deriv y x / ω) * cos (ω * x)
      let G : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => y x * cos (ω * x) - (deriv y x / ω) * sin (ω * x)
      
      have hF_deriv : ∀ x ∈ J, HasDerivAt F 0 x := by
        intro x hx; dsimp [F]; exact aux_deriv_F y lam ω hωsq hωpos x (hy x hx) (hy' x hx)
      have hG_deriv : ∀ x ∈ J, HasDerivAt G 0 x := by
        intro x hx; dsimp [G]; exact aux_deriv_G y lam ω hωsq hωpos x (hy x hx) (hy' x hx)
      
      have hF_const : ∀ x ∈ C, F x = F 0 := by
        have hF_diff : DifferentiableOn ℝ F C := by
          intro x hx
          have hxJ : x ∈ J := connectedComponentIn_subset J 0 hx
          exact (hF_deriv x hxJ).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
        have hF_deriv_zero : C.EqOn (deriv F) 0 := by
          intro x hx
          have hxJ : x ∈ J := connectedComponentIn_subset J 0 hx
          exact (hF_deriv x hxJ).deriv
        intro x hx
        exact hCopen.is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero hCpre hF_diff hF_deriv_zero hx h0C
      
      have hG_const : ∀ x ∈ C, G x = G 0 := by
        have hG_diff : DifferentiableOn ℝ G C := by
          intro x hx
          have hxJ : x ∈ J := connectedComponentIn_subset J 0 hx
          exact (hG_deriv x hxJ).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
        have hG_deriv_zero : C.EqOn (deriv G) 0 := by
          intro x hx
          have hxJ : x ∈ J := connectedComponentIn_subset J 0 hx
          exact (hG_deriv x hxJ).deriv
        intro x hx
        exact hCopen.is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero hCpre hG_diff hG_deriv_zero hx h0C
      
      have hF0 : F 0 = (deriv y 0) / ω := by
        dsimp [F]; simp [hy0]
      have hG0 : G 0 = 0 := by
        dsimp [G]; simp [hy0]
      
      have hG_eq : ∀ x ∈ C, y x * cos (ω * x) = (deriv y x / ω) * sin (ω * x) := by
        intro x hx
        have hGx : G x = 0 := by
          rw [hG_const x hx, hG0]
        dsimp [G] at hGx
        linarith
      
      have hF_eq : ∀ x ∈ C, y x * sin (ω * x) + (deriv y x / ω) * cos (ω * x) = (deriv y 0) / ω := by
        intro x hx
        have hFx : F x = F 0 := hF_const x hx
        dsimp [F] at hFx
        simpa [hy0] using hFx
      
      have hy_solution : ∀ x ∈ C, y x = ((deriv y 0) / ω) * sin (ω * x) := by
        intro x hx
        have hGx := hG_eq x hx
        have hFx := hF_eq x hx
        have hy_sin_expr : y x * sin (ω * x) = (deriv y 0) / ω - (deriv y x / ω) * cos (ω * x) := by
          linarith
        calc
          y x = y x * (sin (ω * x) ^ 2 + cos (ω * x) ^ 2) := by
            rw [Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq, mul_one]
          _ = (y x * cos (ω * x)) * cos (ω * x) + (y x * sin (ω * x)) * sin (ω * x) := by ring
          _ = ((deriv y x / ω) * sin (ω * x)) * cos (ω * x) + 
              ((deriv y 0) / ω - (deriv y x / ω) * cos (ω * x)) * sin (ω * x) := by
            rw [hGx, hy_sin_expr]
          _ = ((deriv y 0) / ω) * sin (ω * x) := by ring
      
      have hypi_solution : y Real.pi = ((deriv y 0) / ω) * sin (ω * Real.pi) := hy_solution Real.pi hpiC
      rw [hypi] at hypi_solution
      
      have hsin_omega_pi : sin (ω * Real.pi) = 0 := by
        by_cases hderiv0zero : deriv y 0 = 0
        · have hy_zero_on_C : ∀ x ∈ C, y x = 0 := by
            intro x hx
            rw [hy_solution x hx, hderiv0zero]; simp
          have hy0zero : y x0 = 0 := hy_zero_on_C x0 hx0C
          exact absurd hy0zero hx0nonz
        · have htemp : ((deriv y 0) / ω) * sin (ω * Real.pi) = 0 := hypi_solution.symm
          have h_cases := mul_eq_zero.mp htemp
          rcases h_cases with (hdiv | hsin)
          · have hzero : deriv y 0 = 0 := by
              calc
                deriv y 0 = ((deriv y 0) / ω) * ω := by field_simp [hωpos.ne']
                _ = 0 * ω := by rw [hdiv]
                _ = 0 := by ring
            exact absurd hzero hderiv0zero
          · exact hsin
      
      rw [Real.sin_eq_zero_iff] at hsin_omega_pi
      rcases hsin_omega_pi with ⟨k, hk⟩
      have hk_eq_omega : (k : ℝ) = ω := by
        nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]
      have hk_pos : (0 : ℤ) < k := by
        by_contra! hk_nonpos
        have hk_nonpos' : (k : ℝ) ≤ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hk_nonpos
        nlinarith
      set n := k.natAbs with hn
      have hn_pos : 0 < n := by
        have hk_ne_zero : k ≠ 0 := by linarith
        exact Int.natAbs_pos.mpr hk_ne_zero
      refine ⟨n, hn_pos, ?_⟩
      calc
        lam = ω^2 := hωsq.symm
        _ = (k : ℝ)^2 := by rw [hk_eq_omega]
        _ = ((n : ℕ) : ℝ)^2 := by simp [hn]
    · have hle : lam ≤ 0 := by linarith
      
      have hg_nonneg_deriv : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) Real.pi, 0 ≤ deriv (fun t : ℝ => y t * deriv y t) x := by
        intro x hx
        have hxJ : x ∈ J := hJsub (Set.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hx.1.le, hx.2.le⟩)
        have hyx : HasDerivAt y (deriv y x) x := hy x hxJ
        have hy'x : HasDerivAt (deriv y) (-(lam * y x)) x := hy' x hxJ
        have hg_deriv : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => y t * deriv y t) ((deriv y x)^2 + y x * (-(lam * y x))) x := by
          have h := HasDerivAt.mul hyx hy'x
          simpa [sq] using h
        have hg_deriv_val : deriv (fun t : ℝ => y t * deriv y t) x = (deriv y x)^2 - lam * (y x)^2 := by
          have := hg_deriv.deriv; rw [this]; ring
        rw [hg_deriv_val]
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (deriv y x), sq_nonneg (y x)]
      
      have hg_cont : ContinuousOn (fun t : ℝ => y t * deriv y t) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) Real.pi) := by
        intro z hz
        have hzJ : z ∈ J := hJsub hz
        have hyz : HasDerivAt y (deriv y z) z := hy z hzJ
        have hy'z : HasDerivAt (deriv y) (-(lam * y z)) z := hy' z hzJ
        exact (ContinuousAt.mul hyz.continuousAt hy'z.continuousAt).continuousWithinAt
      
      have hg_diff : DifferentiableOn ℝ (fun t : ℝ => y t * deriv y t) (Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) Real.pi) := by
        intro z hz
        have hzJ : z ∈ J := hJsub (Set.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hz.1.le, hz.2.le⟩)
        have hyz : HasDerivAt y (deriv y z) z := hy z hzJ
        have hy'z : HasDerivAt (deriv y) (-(lam * y z)) z := hy' z hzJ
        have hg_deriv : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => y t * deriv y t) ((deriv y z)^2 + y z * (-(lam * y z))) z := by
          have h := HasDerivAt.mul hyz hy'z
          simpa [sq] using h
        exact hg_deriv.differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      
      have hg_mono : MonotoneOn (fun t : ℝ => y t * deriv y t) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) Real.pi) := by
        apply monotoneOn_of_deriv_nonneg (convex_Icc 0 Real.pi) hg_cont
        · rw [interior_Icc]; exact hg_diff
        · intro x hx; rw [interior_Icc] at hx; exact hg_nonneg_deriv x hx
      
      have hg0_val : y 0 * deriv y 0 = 0 := by simp [hy0]
      have hgpi_val : y Real.pi * deriv y Real.pi = 0 := by simp [hypi]
      
      have hg_eq0 : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) Real.pi, y x * deriv y x = 0 := by
        intro x hx
        have hx0_mem : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) Real.pi := Set.left_mem_Icc.mpr (by nlinarith [Real.pi_pos])
        have hxpi_mem : Real.pi ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) Real.pi := Set.right_mem_Icc.mpr (by nlinarith [Real.pi_pos])
        have hx0_le_x : (0 : ℝ) ≤ x := hx.1
        have hx_le_pi : x ≤ Real.pi := hx.2
        have hlow : (fun t : ℝ => y t * deriv y t) (0 : ℝ) ≤ (fun t : ℝ => y t * deriv y t) x :=
          hg_mono hx0_mem hx hx0_le_x
        have hhigh : (fun t : ℝ => y t * deriv y t) x ≤ (fun t : ℝ => y t * deriv y t) Real.pi :=
          hg_mono hx hxpi_mem hx_le_pi
        have hlow' : 0 ≤ y x * deriv y x := by simpa [hg0_val] using hlow
        have hhigh' : y x * deriv y x ≤ 0 := by simpa [hgpi_val] using hhigh
        nlinarith
      
      have hy'_x0 : deriv y x0 = 0 := by
        have hprod : y x0 * deriv y x0 = 0 := hg_eq0 x0 hx0Icc
        exact mul_eq_zero.mp hprod |>.resolve_left hx0nonz
      
      by_cases hlam_zero : lam = 0
      · subst hlam_zero
        set C := connectedComponentIn J 0 with hC
        have hCopen : IsOpen C := IsOpen.connectedComponentIn (F := J) (x := 0) hJopen
        have hCpre : IsPreconnected C := isPreconnected_connectedComponentIn
        have h0C : (0 : ℝ) ∈ C := mem_connectedComponentIn h0J
        have hx0C : x0 ∈ C := by
          have hpre_Icc : IsPreconnected (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) Real.pi) := isPreconnected_Icc
          have hsubset : Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) Real.pi ⊆ C :=
            hpre_Icc.subset_connectedComponentIn (Set.left_mem_Icc.mpr (by nlinarith [Real.pi_pos])) hJsub
          exact hsubset hx0Icc
        have hy'_const : ∀ x ∈ C, deriv y x = deriv y 0 := by
          have h_diff : DifferentiableOn ℝ (deriv y) C := by
            intro t ht
            have htJ : t ∈ J := connectedComponentIn_subset J 0 ht
            have h' : HasDerivAt (deriv y) (0 : ℝ) t := by simpa using hy' t htJ
            exact h'.differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
          have h_deriv_zero : C.EqOn (deriv (deriv y)) 0 := by
            intro t ht
            have htJ : t ∈ J := connectedComponentIn_subset J 0 ht
            have h' : HasDerivAt (deriv y) (0 : ℝ) t := by simpa using hy' t htJ
            exact h'.deriv
          intro t ht
          exact hCopen.is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero hCpre h_diff h_deriv_zero ht h0C
        
        have hy'_zero_on_C : ∀ x ∈ C, deriv y x = 0 := by
          intro x hx
          calc
            deriv y x = deriv y 0 := hy'_const x hx
            _ = deriv y x0 := (hy'_const x0 hx0C).symm
            _ = 0 := hy'_x0
        
        have hy_zero_on_C : ∀ x ∈ C, y x = 0 := by
          have hy_diff : DifferentiableOn ℝ y C := by
            intro t ht
            have htJ : t ∈ J := connectedComponentIn_subset J 0 ht
            exact (hy t htJ).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
          have hy_deriv_zero : C.EqOn (deriv y) 0 := by
            intro t ht
            exact hy'_zero_on_C t ht
          intro x hx
          have h_eq := hCopen.is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero hCpre hy_diff hy_deriv_zero hx h0C
          rw [hy0] at h_eq
          exact h_eq
        
        have hy0_x0 : y x0 = 0 := hy_zero_on_C x0 hx0C
        exact absurd hy0_x0 hx0nonz
      · have hlam_neg : lam < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne hle hlam_zero
        
        set C := connectedComponentIn J 0 with hC
        have hCopen : IsOpen C := IsOpen.connectedComponentIn (F := J) (x := 0) hJopen
        have hCpre : IsPreconnected C := isPreconnected_connectedComponentIn
        have h0C : (0 : ℝ) ∈ C := mem_connectedComponentIn h0J
        have hx0C : x0 ∈ C := by
          have hpre_Icc : IsPreconnected (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) Real.pi) := isPreconnected_Icc
          have hsubset : Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) Real.pi ⊆ C :=
            hpre_Icc.subset_connectedComponentIn (Set.left_mem_Icc.mpr (by nlinarith [Real.pi_pos])) hJsub
          exact hsubset hx0Icc
        
        let E : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => (deriv y x)^2 + lam * (y x)^2
        have hE_deriv : ∀ x ∈ J, HasDerivAt E 0 x := by
          intro x hx
          have hyx : HasDerivAt y (deriv y x) x := hy x hx
          have hy'x : HasDerivAt (deriv y) (-(lam * y x)) x := hy' x hx
          have h_deriv_sq1 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => (deriv y t)^2) (2 * (deriv y x) * (-(lam * y x))) x := by
            have htemp := HasDerivAt.mul hy'x hy'x
            have h_eq : 2 * (deriv y x) * (-(lam * y x)) = (-(lam * y x * deriv y x) + -(deriv y x * (lam * y x))) := by ring
            have htemp' : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => (deriv y t)^2) (-(lam * y x * deriv y x) + -(deriv y x * (lam * y x))) x := by
              simpa [sq] using htemp
            simpa [h_eq] using htemp'
          have h_deriv_sq2 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => lam * (y t)^2) (lam * (2 * y x * (deriv y x))) x := by
            have h_sq : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => (y t)^2) (2 * y x * (deriv y x)) x := by
              have htemp := HasDerivAt.mul hyx hyx
              have h_eq : 2 * y x * (deriv y x) = (deriv y x * y x + y x * deriv y x) := by ring
              have htemp' : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => (y t)^2) (deriv y x * y x + y x * deriv y x) x := by
                simpa [sq] using htemp
              simpa [h_eq] using htemp'
            simpa [mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using (HasDerivAt.const_mul lam h_sq)
          have hE : HasDerivAt E (2 * (deriv y x) * (-(lam * y x)) + lam * (2 * y x * (deriv y x))) x :=
            HasDerivAt.add h_deriv_sq1 h_deriv_sq2
          have h_simplify : -(2 * (deriv y x) * (lam * y x)) + lam * (2 * y x * (deriv y x)) = 0 := by ring
          have h_eq : 2 * (deriv y x) * (-(lam * y x)) + lam * (2 * y x * (deriv y x)) = -(2 * (deriv y x) * (lam * y x)) + lam * (2 * y x * (deriv y x)) := by ring
          simpa [h_eq, h_simplify] using hE
        
        have hE_const : ∀ x ∈ C, E x = E 0 := by
          have hE_diff : DifferentiableOn ℝ E C := by
            intro x hx
            have hxJ : x ∈ J := connectedComponentIn_subset J 0 hx
            exact (hE_deriv x hxJ).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
          have hE_deriv_zero : C.EqOn (deriv E) 0 := by
            intro x hx
            have hxJ : x ∈ J := connectedComponentIn_subset J 0 hx
            exact (hE_deriv x hxJ).deriv
          intro x hx
          exact hCopen.is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero hCpre hE_diff hE_deriv_zero hx h0C
        
        have hE0 : E 0 = (deriv y 0)^2 := by
          dsimp [E]; simp [hy0]
        
        have h_rolle : ∃ c ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) Real.pi, deriv y c = 0 := by
          have h_cont : ContinuousOn y (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) Real.pi) := by
            intro z hz
            have hzJ : z ∈ J := hJsub hz
            exact (hy z hzJ).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
          exact exists_deriv_eq_zero (by exact Real.pi_pos) h_cont (by rw [hy0, hypi])
        
        rcases h_rolle with ⟨c, hc_mem, hc_deriv⟩
        
        have hcC : c ∈ C := by
          have hpre_Icc : IsPreconnected (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) Real.pi) := isPreconnected_Icc
          have hsubset : Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) Real.pi ⊆ C :=
            hpre_Icc.subset_connectedComponentIn (Set.left_mem_Icc.mpr (by nlinarith [Real.pi_pos])) hJsub
          exact hsubset (Set.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hc_mem.1.le, hc_mem.2.le⟩)
        
        have hEc : E c = lam * (y c)^2 := by
          dsimp [E]; simp [hc_deriv]
        
        have hEc_eq_E0 : E c = E 0 := hE_const c hcC
        rw [hE0, hEc] at hEc_eq_E0
        
        have hderiv0_zero : deriv y 0 = 0 := by
          have h_nonpos : (deriv y 0)^2 ≤ 0 := by
            have h_rhs_nonpos : lam * (y c)^2 ≤ 0 := mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (by linarith) (sq_nonneg _)
            nlinarith
          nlinarith
        
        have hE_zero_at_x0 : E x0 = 0 := by
          rw [hE_const x0 hx0C, hE0, hderiv0_zero]; simp
        dsimp [E] at hE_zero_at_x0
        
        have hy'_x0_nonzero : deriv y x0 ≠ 0 := by
          have h_neg_lam_pos : 0 < -lam := by linarith
          have h_y_sq_pos : 0 < (y x0)^2 := pow_two_pos_of_ne_zero hx0nonz
          have h_pos : 0 < -lam * (y x0)^2 := mul_pos h_neg_lam_pos h_y_sq_pos
          have h_eq : (deriv y x0)^2 = -lam * (y x0)^2 := by nlinarith
          have h_sq_pos : 0 < (deriv y x0)^2 := by rw [h_eq]; exact h_pos
          intro hzero
          apply h_sq_pos.ne.symm
          simpa [hzero]
        
        have hprod_zero : y x0 * deriv y x0 = 0 := hg_eq0 x0 hx0Icc
        have hy'_x0_zero : deriv y x0 = 0 := mul_eq_zero.mp hprod_zero |>.resolve_left hx0nonz
        
        exact absurd hy'_x0_zero hy'_x0_nonzero
    
  · intro h
    rcases h with ⟨n, hnpos, hlam⟩
    subst hlam
    set y := fun x : ℝ => sin ((n : ℝ) * x) with hy
    refine ⟨y, Set.univ, isOpen_univ, by intro x hx; exact trivial, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro x _
      have h_deriv : HasDerivAt y ((n : ℝ) * cos ((n : ℝ) * x)) x := by
        dsimp [y]
        have hc : HasDerivAt (fun x' : ℝ => (n : ℝ) * x') (n : ℝ) x := by
          simpa using (HasDerivAt.const_mul (n : ℝ) (hasDerivAt_id x))
        simpa [mul_comm] using hc.sin
      have h_deriv_val : deriv y x = (n : ℝ) * cos ((n : ℝ) * x) := h_deriv.deriv
      rw [h_deriv_val]
      exact h_deriv
    · intro x _
      have h_deriv_y_val : deriv y = fun x' : ℝ => (n : ℝ) * cos ((n : ℝ) * x') := by
        ext x'
        have h_deriv_y_x' : HasDerivAt y ((n : ℝ) * cos ((n : ℝ) * x')) x' := by
          dsimp [y]
          have hc : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℝ => (n : ℝ) * z) (n : ℝ) x' := by
            simpa using (HasDerivAt.const_mul (n : ℝ) (hasDerivAt_id x'))
          simpa [mul_comm] using hc.sin
        exact h_deriv_y_x'.deriv
      rw [h_deriv_y_val]
      have h_deriv_second : HasDerivAt (fun x' : ℝ => (n : ℝ) * cos ((n : ℝ) * x')) (-((n : ℝ)^2) * sin ((n : ℝ) * x)) x := by
        have hc2 : HasDerivAt (fun x' : ℝ => (n : ℝ) * x') (n : ℝ) x := by
          simpa using (HasDerivAt.const_mul (n : ℝ) (hasDerivAt_id x))
        have hcos : HasDerivAt (fun x' : ℝ => cos ((n : ℝ) * x')) (-sin ((n : ℝ) * x) * (n : ℝ)) x :=
          ((Real.hasDerivAt_cos ((n : ℝ) * x)).comp x hc2)
        have h_mul : HasDerivAt (fun x' : ℝ => (n : ℝ) * cos ((n : ℝ) * x')) ((n : ℝ) * (-sin ((n : ℝ) * x) * (n : ℝ))) x :=
          (HasDerivAt.const_mul (n : ℝ) hcos)
        have h_simplify : (n : ℝ) * (-sin ((n : ℝ) * x) * (n : ℝ)) = -((n : ℝ)^2) * sin ((n : ℝ) * x) := by ring
        rw [h_simplify] at h_mul
        exact h_mul
      have h_eq_goal : -(((n : ℝ) ^ 2) * y x) = -((n : ℝ)^2) * sin ((n : ℝ) * x) := by
        dsimp [y]; ring
      simpa [h_eq_goal] using h_deriv_second
    · dsimp [y]; simp
    · dsimp [y]; simpa using Real.sin_nat_mul_pi n
    · have hpos : 0 < Real.pi / (2 * (n : ℝ)) := by
        have h2n_pos : 0 < 2 * (n : ℝ) := by
          have hnpos' : (0 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hnpos
          nlinarith
        exact div_pos Real.pi_pos h2n_pos
      have hlt : Real.pi / (2 * (n : ℝ)) < Real.pi := by
        have hnpos' : (1 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.one_le_of_lt hnpos)
        have h2n_pos : 0 < 2 * (n : ℝ) := by nlinarith
        have h2n_gt_one : 1 < 2 * (n : ℝ) := by nlinarith
        have h_recip : 1 / (2 * (n : ℝ)) < 1 := by
          have hpos_one : 0 < (1 : ℝ) := by norm_num
          have htemp := (one_div_lt_one_div h2n_pos hpos_one).mpr h2n_gt_one
          simpa using htemp
        calc
          Real.pi / (2 * (n : ℝ)) = Real.pi * (1 / (2 * (n : ℝ))) := by ring
          _ < Real.pi * 1 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h_recip Real.pi_pos
          _ = Real.pi := by simp
      have hx_mem : Real.pi / (2 * (n : ℝ)) ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) Real.pi :=
        Set.mem_Ioo.mpr ⟨hpos, hlt⟩
      have hy_nonzero : y (Real.pi / (2 * (n : ℝ))) ≠ 0 := by
        dsimp [y]
        have h_arg : (n : ℝ) * (Real.pi / (2 * (n : ℝ))) = Real.pi / 2 := by
          field_simp [show (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 from Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hnpos.ne']
        rw [h_arg]
        rw [Real.sin_pi_div_two]
        norm_num
      exact ⟨Real.pi / (2 * (n : ℝ)), hx_mem, hy_nonzero⟩

end Submission

import Mathlib

namespace Submission

namespace LeanEval
namespace Combinatorics

open scoped BigOperators

/-!
The Markoff graph over `ZMod p`.

Vertices are nonzero solutions to the Markoff equation
`x₀² + x₁² + x₂² = 3 x₀ x₁ x₂`,
and edges are generated by the three Vieta involutions.
-/

abbrev MarkoffTriple (p : ℕ) :=
  { x : Fin 3 → ZMod p //
      x ≠ 0 ∧ x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 + x 2 ^ 2 = (3 : ZMod p) * x 0 * x 1 * x 2 }

def markoffGraph (p : ℕ) : SimpleGraph (MarkoffTriple p) where
  Adj x y :=
    x ≠ y ∧
      ((y.1 0 = (3 : ZMod p) * x.1 1 * x.1 2 - x.1 0 ∧ y.1 1 = x.1 1 ∧ y.1 2 = x.1 2) ∨
       (y.1 1 = (3 : ZMod p) * x.1 0 * x.1 2 - x.1 1 ∧ y.1 0 = x.1 0 ∧ y.1 2 = x.1 2) ∨
       (y.1 2 = (3 : ZMod p) * x.1 0 * x.1 1 - x.1 2 ∧ y.1 0 = x.1 0 ∧ y.1 1 = x.1 1))
  symm.symm := by
    intro x y hxy
    rcases hxy with ⟨hneq, hmove | hmove | hmove⟩
    · constructor
      · exact hneq.symm
      · refine Or.inl ?_
        rcases hmove with ⟨h0, h1, h2⟩
        constructor
        · rw [h1, h2, h0]
          simp [sub_eq_add_neg, add_left_comm, add_comm]
        · exact ⟨by simp [h1], by simp [h2]⟩
    · constructor
      · exact hneq.symm
      · refine Or.inr <| Or.inl ?_
        rcases hmove with ⟨h1, h0, h2⟩
        constructor
        · rw [h0, h2, h1]
          simp [sub_eq_add_neg, add_left_comm, add_comm]
        · exact ⟨by simp [h0], by simp [h2]⟩
    · constructor
      · exact hneq.symm
      · refine Or.inr <| Or.inr ?_
        rcases hmove with ⟨h2, h0, h1⟩
        constructor
        · rw [h0, h1, h2]
          simp [sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm]
        · exact ⟨by simp [h0], by simp [h1]⟩
  loopless := ⟨fun _ h => h.1 rfl⟩





end Combinatorics
end LeanEval

open LeanEval.Combinatorics
open scoped BigOperators
/-ResultDefinitionsBegin-/
/-ResultProofDefinitionsBegin-/
namespace LeanEval.Combinatorics

/-- the first Vieta move on coordinate functions -/
def vt0_fun {p : ℕ} (x : Fin 3 → ZMod p) : Fin 3 → ZMod p :=
  fun i => if i = (0 : Fin 3) then (3 : ZMod p) * x 1 * x 2 - x 0 else x i

def vt1_fun {p : ℕ} (x : Fin 3 → ZMod p) : Fin 3 → ZMod p :=
  fun i => if i = (1 : Fin 3) then (3 : ZMod p) * x 0 * x 2 - x 1 else x i

def vt2_fun {p : ℕ} (x : Fin 3 → ZMod p) : Fin 3 → ZMod p :=
  fun i => if i = (2 : Fin 3) then (3 : ZMod p) * x 0 * x 1 - x 2 else x i

@[simp] lemma vt0_fun_0 {p} (x : Fin 3 → ZMod p) : vt0_fun x 0 = (3 : ZMod p) * x 1 * x 2 - x 0 := by simp [vt0_fun]
@[simp] lemma vt0_fun_1 {p} (x : Fin 3 → ZMod p) : vt0_fun x 1 = x 1 := by simp [vt0_fun]
@[simp] lemma vt0_fun_2 {p} (x : Fin 3 → ZMod p) : vt0_fun x 2 = x 2 := by simp [vt0_fun]
@[simp] lemma vt1_fun_0 {p} (x : Fin 3 → ZMod p) : vt1_fun x 0 = x 0 := by simp [vt1_fun]
@[simp] lemma vt1_fun_1 {p} (x : Fin 3 → ZMod p) : vt1_fun x 1 = (3 : ZMod p) * x 0 * x 2 - x 1 := by simp [vt1_fun]
@[simp] lemma vt1_fun_2 {p} (x : Fin 3 → ZMod p) : vt1_fun x 2 = x 2 := by simp [vt1_fun]
@[simp] lemma vt2_fun_0 {p} (x : Fin 3 → ZMod p) : vt2_fun x 0 = x 0 := by simp [vt2_fun]
@[simp] lemma vt2_fun_1 {p} (x : Fin 3 → ZMod p) : vt2_fun x 1 = x 1 := by simp [vt2_fun]
@[simp] lemma vt2_fun_2 {p} (x : Fin 3 → ZMod p) : vt2_fun x 2 = (3 : ZMod p) * x 0 * x 1 - x 2 := by simp [vt2_fun]

lemma fin3_ext' {R : Type*} {f g : Fin 3 → R}
 (h0 : f 0 = g 0) (h1 : f 1 = g 1) (h2 : f 2 = g 2) : f = g := by
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;> assumption

def vieta0 {p : ℕ} (x : MarkoffTriple p) : MarkoffTriple p := by
  classical
  refine ⟨vt0_fun x.1, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro hzero
    have h0 : vt0_fun x.1 0 = (0 : Fin 3 → ZMod p) 0 := congrFun hzero 0
    have h1 : vt0_fun x.1 1 = (0 : Fin 3 → ZMod p) 1 := congrFun hzero 1
    have h2 : vt0_fun x.1 2 = (0 : Fin 3 → ZMod p) 2 := congrFun hzero 2
    have xb : x.1 1 = 0 := by simpa using h1
    have xc : x.1 2 = 0 := by simpa using h2
    have xa : x.1 0 = 0 := by
      -- using the zero first new coordinate
      simp [xb, xc] at h0
      -- h0 : - x0 = 0 maybe simp gives?
      exact h0
    apply x.2.1
    apply fin3_ext'
    all_goals simp [xa, xb, xc]
  · -- equation
    have hx := x.2.2
    -- simplify values
    simp at hx ⊢ -- maybe simp doesn't change eq?
    -- use linear_combination
    linear_combination hx



def vieta1 {p : ℕ} (x : MarkoffTriple p) : MarkoffTriple p := by
  classical
  refine ⟨vt1_fun x.1, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro hzero
    have h0 : vt1_fun x.1 0 = (0 : Fin 3 → ZMod p) 0 := congrFun hzero 0
    have h1 : vt1_fun x.1 1 = (0 : Fin 3 → ZMod p) 1 := congrFun hzero 1
    have h2 : vt1_fun x.1 2 = (0 : Fin 3 → ZMod p) 2 := congrFun hzero 2
    have xa : x.1 0 = 0 := by simpa using h0
    have xc : x.1 2 = 0 := by simpa using h2
    have xb : x.1 1 = 0 := by
      simp [xa, xc] at h1
      exact h1
    apply x.2.1
    apply fin3_ext'
    all_goals simp [xa, xb, xc]
  · have hx := x.2.2
    simp at hx ⊢
    linear_combination hx

def vieta2 {p : ℕ} (x : MarkoffTriple p) : MarkoffTriple p := by
  classical
  refine ⟨vt2_fun x.1, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro hzero
    have h0 : vt2_fun x.1 0 = (0 : Fin 3 → ZMod p) 0 := congrFun hzero 0
    have h1 : vt2_fun x.1 1 = (0 : Fin 3 → ZMod p) 1 := congrFun hzero 1
    have h2 : vt2_fun x.1 2 = (0 : Fin 3 → ZMod p) 2 := congrFun hzero 2
    have xa : x.1 0 = 0 := by simpa using h0
    have xb : x.1 1 = 0 := by simpa using h1
    have xc : x.1 2 = 0 := by
      simp [xa, xb] at h2
      exact h2
    apply x.2.1
    apply fin3_ext'
    all_goals simp [xa, xb, xc]
  · have hx := x.2.2
    simp at hx ⊢
    linear_combination hx

-- Index the three involutions by `Fin 3`.
def vieta {p : ℕ} (i : Fin 3) (x : MarkoffTriple p) : MarkoffTriple p :=
  match i.1 with
  | 0 => vieta0 x
  | 1 => vieta1 x
  | _ => vieta2 x

@[simp] lemma vieta_idx0 {p : ℕ} (x : MarkoffTriple p) : vieta (0 : Fin 3) x = vieta0 x := rfl
@[simp] lemma vieta_idx1 {p : ℕ} (x : MarkoffTriple p) : vieta (1 : Fin 3) x = vieta1 x := rfl
@[simp] lemma vieta_idx2 {p : ℕ} (x : MarkoffTriple p) : vieta (2 : Fin 3) x = vieta2 x := rfl

@[simp] lemma vieta0_val {p : ℕ} (x : MarkoffTriple p) : (vieta0 x).1 = vt0_fun x.1 := rfl
@[simp] lemma vieta1_val {p : ℕ} (x : MarkoffTriple p) : (vieta1 x).1 = vt1_fun x.1 := rfl
@[simp] lemma vieta2_val {p : ℕ} (x : MarkoffTriple p) : (vieta2 x).1 = vt2_fun x.1 := rfl

/-- The coordinate formula really is an involution, without any hypothesis on
    the coordinates.  These identities are useful when using the generated
    words as genuine permutations of the finite Markoff surface. -/
@[simp] lemma vt0_fun_invol {p} (x : Fin 3 → ZMod p) :
    vt0_fun (vt0_fun x) = x := by
  apply fin3_ext'
  · simp [sub_eq_add_neg]
  · simp
  · simp

@[simp] lemma vt1_fun_invol {p} (x : Fin 3 → ZMod p) :
    vt1_fun (vt1_fun x) = x := by
  apply fin3_ext'
  · simp
  · simp [sub_eq_add_neg]
  · simp

@[simp] lemma vt2_fun_invol {p} (x : Fin 3 → ZMod p) :
    vt2_fun (vt2_fun x) = x := by
  apply fin3_ext'
  · simp
  · simp
  · simp [sub_eq_add_neg]

@[simp] lemma vieta0_invol {p : ℕ} (x : MarkoffTriple p) :
    vieta0 (vieta0 x) = x := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact vt0_fun_invol x.1

@[simp] lemma vieta1_invol {p : ℕ} (x : MarkoffTriple p) :
    vieta1 (vieta1 x) = x := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact vt1_fun_invol x.1

@[simp] lemma vieta2_invol {p : ℕ} (x : MarkoffTriple p) :
    vieta2 (vieta2 x) = x := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact vt2_fun_invol x.1

@[simp] lemma vieta_invol {p : ℕ} (i : Fin 3) (x : MarkoffTriple p) :
    vieta i (vieta i x) = x := by
  fin_cases i <;> simp

lemma markoff_adj_iff_vieta {p : ℕ} (x y : MarkoffTriple p) :
    (markoffGraph p).Adj x y ↔ x ≠ y ∧ ∃ i : Fin 3, y = vieta i x := by
  classical
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hne, hm⟩
    refine ⟨hne, ?_⟩
    rcases hm with h | h | h
    · refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
      rcases h with ⟨h0, h1, h2⟩
      apply Subtype.ext
      apply fin3_ext'
      · simpa using h0
      · simpa using h1
      · simpa using h2
    · refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
      rcases h with ⟨h1, h0, h2⟩
      apply Subtype.ext
      apply fin3_ext'
      · simpa using h0
      · simpa using h1
      · simpa using h2
    · refine ⟨2, ?_⟩
      rcases h with ⟨h2, h0, h1⟩
      apply Subtype.ext
      apply fin3_ext'
      · simpa using h0
      · simpa using h1
      · simpa using h2
  · rintro ⟨hne, ⟨i, hi⟩⟩
    refine ⟨hne, ?_⟩
    fin_cases i
    · left
      subst y
      constructor
      · simp [vieta, vt0_fun]
      · constructor <;> simp [vieta, vt0_fun]
    · right; left
      subst y
      constructor
      · simp [vieta, vt1_fun]
      · constructor <;> simp [vieta, vt1_fun]
    · right; right
      subst y
      constructor
      · simp [vieta, vt2_fun]
      · constructor <;> simp [vieta, vt2_fun]

/-- One of the three Vieta operations; this includes a stationary operation when
one of the involutions fixes its input.  Reflexive transitive closure removes
that harmless distinction from `markoffGraph.Adj`. -/
def markoffStep {p : ℕ} (x y : MarkoffTriple p) : Prop :=
  ∃ i : Fin 3, y = vieta i x

lemma reachable_iff_reflTransGen_step {p : ℕ} (x y : MarkoffTriple p) :
    (markoffGraph p).Reachable x y ↔ Relation.ReflTransGen (@markoffStep p) x y := by
  constructor
  · intro hxy
    have h := ((markoffGraph p).reachable_iff_reflTransGen x y).1 hxy
    -- every honest edge is a step
    exact h.mono (fun a b hab => (markoff_adj_iff_vieta a b).1 hab |>.2)
  · intro hxy
    have step_one : ∀ a b : MarkoffTriple p, markoffStep a b →
        Relation.ReflTransGen (markoffGraph p).Adj a b := by
      intro a b h
      by_cases e : a = b
      · simpa [e]
        using (Relation.ReflTransGen.refl :
          Relation.ReflTransGen (markoffGraph p).Adj b b)
      · exact Relation.ReflTransGen.single
          ((markoff_adj_iff_vieta a b).2 ⟨e, h⟩)
    have hh : Relation.ReflTransGen (markoffGraph p).Adj x y := by
      refine Relation.ReflTransGen.trans_induction_on hxy ?_ ?_ ?_
      · intro a; exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
      · intro a b h
        exact step_one a b h
      · intro a b c hab hbc ih1 ih2
        exact ih1.trans ih2
    exact ((markoffGraph p).reachable_iff_reflTransGen x y).2 hh

/-- Successively apply a word in the three moves, left to right. -/
def applyVietas {p : ℕ} : List (Fin 3) → MarkoffTriple p → MarkoffTriple p
  | [], x => x
  | i :: l, x => applyVietas l (vieta i x)

lemma invariant_applyVietas {p : ℕ} (f : MarkoffTriple p → ZMod p)
    (hf : ∀ (x : MarkoffTriple p) (i : Fin 3), f (vieta i x) = f x) :
    ∀ (l : List (Fin 3)) (x : MarkoffTriple p), f (applyVietas l x) = f x := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro x; rfl
  | cons i l ih =>
    intro x
    change f (applyVietas l (vieta i x)) = f x
    exact (ih (vieta i x)).trans (hf x i)

lemma applyVietas_append {p : ℕ} (l₁ l₂ : List (Fin 3)) (x : MarkoffTriple p) :
    applyVietas (l₁ ++ l₂) x = applyVietas l₂ (applyVietas l₁ x) := by
  induction l₁ generalizing x with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons i l ih =>
    simpa [applyVietas] using (ih (vieta i x))

lemma reflTransGen_step_iff_word {p : ℕ} (x y : MarkoffTriple p) :
    Relation.ReflTransGen (@markoffStep p) x y ↔
      ∃ l : List (Fin 3), applyVietas l x = y := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    induction h with
    | refl => exact ⟨[], rfl⟩
    | @tail b c hab hbc ih =>
      rcases ih with ⟨l, hl⟩
      rcases hbc with ⟨i, hi⟩
      refine ⟨l ++ [i], ?_⟩
      -- append the last operation at the right hand end of the word
      simp [applyVietas_append, hl, hi, applyVietas]
  · rintro ⟨l, hly⟩
    subst y
    induction l generalizing x with
    | nil => exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
    | cons i l ih =>
      have one : markoffStep x (vieta i x) := ⟨i, rfl⟩
      exact (Relation.ReflTransGen.single one).trans (ih (x := vieta i x))

lemma reachable_iff_word {p : ℕ} (x y : MarkoffTriple p) :
    (markoffGraph p).Reachable x y ↔
      ∃ l : List (Fin 3), applyVietas l x = y := by
  rw [reachable_iff_reflTransGen_step, reflTransGen_step_iff_word]


-- On a fibre of two fixed coordinates the quadratic equation has just its two
-- usual roots.  The nontrivial root is precisely the corresponding Vieta move.
lemma eq_or_vieta0_of_tail {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime]
    (x y : MarkoffTriple p)
    (h1 : x.1 1 = y.1 1) (h2 : x.1 2 = y.1 2) :
    x = y ∨ y = vieta0 x := by
  classical
  have hx := x.2.2
  have hy := y.2.2
  -- make a common name for the fixed entries by rewriting `y`
  rw [← h1, ← h2] at hy
  have prod :
      (x.1 0 - y.1 0) * (x.1 0 + y.1 0 - (3 : ZMod p) * x.1 1 * x.1 2) = 0 := by
    linear_combination hx - hy
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp prod with h | h
  · left
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply fin3_ext'
    · exact sub_eq_zero.mp h
    · exact h1
    · exact h2
  · right
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply fin3_ext'
    · have hsum : x.1 0 + y.1 0 = (3 : ZMod p) * x.1 1 * x.1 2 :=
        sub_eq_zero.mp h
      -- isolate the other root
      have : y.1 0 = (3 : ZMod p) * x.1 1 * x.1 2 - x.1 0 := by
        linear_combination hsum
      simpa using this
    · simpa using h1.symm
    · simpa using h2.symm

lemma eq_or_vieta1_of_side {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime]
    (x y : MarkoffTriple p)
    (h0 : x.1 0 = y.1 0) (h2 : x.1 2 = y.1 2) :
    x = y ∨ y = vieta1 x := by
  classical
  have hx := x.2.2
  have hy := y.2.2
  rw [← h0, ← h2] at hy
  have prod :
      (x.1 1 - y.1 1) *
        (x.1 1 + y.1 1 - (3 : ZMod p) * x.1 0 * x.1 2) = 0 := by
    linear_combination hx - hy
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp prod with h | h
  · left
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply fin3_ext'
    · exact h0
    · exact sub_eq_zero.mp h
    · exact h2
  · right
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply fin3_ext'
    · simpa using h0.symm
    · have hsum : x.1 1 + y.1 1 = (3 : ZMod p) * x.1 0 * x.1 2 :=
        sub_eq_zero.mp h
      have : y.1 1 = (3 : ZMod p) * x.1 0 * x.1 2 - x.1 1 := by
        linear_combination hsum
      simpa using this
    · simpa using h2.symm

lemma eq_or_vieta2_of_head {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime]
    (x y : MarkoffTriple p)
    (h0 : x.1 0 = y.1 0) (h1 : x.1 1 = y.1 1) :
    x = y ∨ y = vieta2 x := by
  classical
  have hx := x.2.2
  have hy := y.2.2
  rw [← h0, ← h1] at hy
  have prod :
      (x.1 2 - y.1 2) *
        (x.1 2 + y.1 2 - (3 : ZMod p) * x.1 0 * x.1 1) = 0 := by
    linear_combination hx - hy
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp prod with h | h
  · left
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply fin3_ext'
    · exact h0
    · exact h1
    · exact sub_eq_zero.mp h
  · right
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply fin3_ext'
    · simpa using h0.symm
    · simpa using h1.symm
    · have hsum : x.1 2 + y.1 2 = (3 : ZMod p) * x.1 0 * x.1 1 :=
        sub_eq_zero.mp h
      have : y.1 2 = (3 : ZMod p) * x.1 0 * x.1 1 - x.1 2 := by
        linear_combination hsum
      simpa using this


/-- Translation by a nonzero field element generates the additive group of the
prime field. This elementary form is useful on a parabolic conic fiber,
where the two Vieta moves compose to a translation. -/
lemma zmod_translate_const {p : ℕ} (hp : Nat.Prime p)
    (d : ZMod p) (hd : d ≠ 0) (g : ZMod p → ZMod p)
    (hg : ∀ z : ZMod p, g (z + d) = g z) :
    ∀ z : ZMod p, g z = g 0 := by
  classical
  letI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  letI : NeZero p := ⟨hp.ne_zero⟩
  have step : ∀ (n : ℕ) (z : ZMod p),
      g (z + (n : ZMod p) * d) = g z := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
        intro z
        simp
    | succ n ih =>
        intro z
        calc
          g (z + (n + 1 : ℕ) * d) =
              g ((z + (n : ZMod p) * d) + d) := by
                congr 1
                push_cast
                ring
          _ = g (z + (n : ZMod p) * d) := hg _
          _ = g z := ih z
  intro z
  let t : ZMod p := z / d
  have ht : t * d = z := by
    dsimp [t]
    exact div_mul_cancel₀ z hd
  have hval : ((t.val : ℕ) : ZMod p) = t :=
    ZMod.natCast_zmod_val t
  calc
    g z = g (0 + (t.val : ZMod p) * d) := by rw [hval, ht, zero_add]
    _ = g 0 := step t.val 0

/-- Consequently any translation-invariant `ZMod`-valued function over the
prime field has zero sum.  We do not assume a choice of generator for the
cyclic additive group: `zmod_translate_const` proves constancy using the
`val` representative. -/
lemma zmod_sum_translate_zero {p : ℕ} [NeZero p] (hp : Nat.Prime p)
    (d : ZMod p) (hd : d ≠ 0) (g : ZMod p → ZMod p)
    (hg : ∀ z : ZMod p, g (z + d) = g z) :
    (∑ z : ZMod p, g z) = 0 := by
  classical
  letI : NeZero p := ⟨hp.ne_zero⟩
  have hconst : ∀ z : ZMod p, g z = g 0 :=
    zmod_translate_const hp d hd g hg
  simp_rw [hconst]
  -- There are exactly `p` copies of `g 0`, and the characteristic is `p`.
  simp [Finset.sum_const, ZMod.card, nsmul_eq_mul]



/-- Simultaneously negating two coordinates preserves the Markoff surface and
commutes with each of the Vieta operations. It exchanges the two parabolic
slices.  We keep track of it here without adding graph generators. -/
def neg01 {p : ℕ} (x : MarkoffTriple p) : MarkoffTriple p := by
  classical
  refine ⟨![- x.1 0, - x.1 1, x.1 2], ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro hz
    apply x.2.1
    apply fin3_ext'
    · have h := congrFun hz (0 : Fin 3)
      dsimp at h
      -- in an additive group `-a=0` also gives `a=0`
      have : x.1 0 = 0 := by
        simpa using (neg_eq_zero.mp h)
      simpa using this
    · have h := congrFun hz (1 : Fin 3)
      dsimp at h
      have : x.1 1 = 0 := by
        simpa using (neg_eq_zero.mp h)
      simpa using this
    · have h := congrFun hz (2 : Fin 3)
      simpa using h
  · dsimp
    have hx := x.2.2
    -- both signs occur either squared or as a pair in the product
    linear_combination hx

@[simp] lemma neg01_0 {p : ℕ} (x : MarkoffTriple p) :
    (neg01 x).1 0 = - x.1 0 := rfl
@[simp] lemma neg01_1 {p : ℕ} (x : MarkoffTriple p) :
    (neg01 x).1 1 = - x.1 1 := rfl
@[simp] lemma neg01_2 {p : ℕ} (x : MarkoffTriple p) :
    (neg01 x).1 2 = x.1 2 := rfl

@[simp] lemma neg01_invol {p : ℕ} (x : MarkoffTriple p) :
    neg01 (neg01 x) = x := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply fin3_ext'
  · simp
  · simp
  · simp

lemma neg01_vieta0 {p : ℕ} (x : MarkoffTriple p) :
    neg01 (vieta0 x) = vieta0 (neg01 x) := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply fin3_ext'
  · simp [sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm]
  · simp
  · simp
lemma neg01_vieta1 {p : ℕ} (x : MarkoffTriple p) :
    neg01 (vieta1 x) = vieta1 (neg01 x) := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply fin3_ext'
  · simp
  · simp [sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm]
  · simp
lemma neg01_vieta2 {p : ℕ} (x : MarkoffTriple p) :
    neg01 (vieta2 x) = vieta2 (neg01 x) := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply fin3_ext'
  · simp
  · simp
  · simp [sub_eq_add_neg]

lemma neg01_vieta {p : ℕ} (i : Fin 3) (x : MarkoffTriple p) :
    neg01 (vieta i x) = vieta i (neg01 x) := by
  fin_cases i
  · exact neg01_vieta0 x
  · exact neg01_vieta1 x
  · exact neg01_vieta2 x

/-- The parabolic slice with `3*a = 2` is an affine line (for each of its two
possible differences).  On each such line the two other Vieta moves compose
to translation by `-2*d`.  This calculation isolates the only order-`p`
rotation; it is often the useful starting point in the Markoff orbit
analysis. -/
lemma sum_fibre_parabolic_pos_zero {p : ℕ} [NeZero p]
    [Fintype (MarkoffTriple p)] (hp : Nat.Prime p)
    (a : ZMod p) (ha : a ≠ 0) (htwo : (2 : ZMod p) ≠ 0)
    (hpar : (3 : ZMod p) * a = 2)
    (f : MarkoffTriple p → ZMod p)
    (hf : ∀ (x : MarkoffTriple p) (i : Fin 3), f (vieta i x) = f x) :
    (∑ x : {x : MarkoffTriple p // x.1 0 = a}, f x.1) = 0 := by
  classical
  letI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  -- A point on this slice is uniquely `(a,c+d,c)`, with `d^2=-a^2`.
  let D := {d : ZMod p // d^2 = - a^2}
  let back : D × ZMod p → MarkoffTriple p := fun u =>
    ⟨![a, u.1.1 + u.2, u.2], by
       intro hz
       have h := congrFun hz (0 : Fin 3)
       simpa using (ha (by simpa using h)),
     by
       have hd := u.1.2
       dsimp [D] at hd
       -- substitute `d^2=-a^2`; the remaining equality is just `(3*a)=2`
       dsimp
       linear_combination hd - ( (u.1.1 + u.2) * u.2) * hpar ⟩
  -- tails of the equivalence
  have back0 (u : D × ZMod p) : (back u).1 0 = a := by
    rfl
  let e : {x : MarkoffTriple p // x.1 0 = a} ≃ D × ZMod p :=
    { toFun := fun x =>
        ((⟨x.1.1 1 - x.1.1 2, by
            dsimp [D]
            have hx := x.1.2.2
            rw [x.2] at hx
            -- put `3*a=2` into the equation of the slice
            -- (`ring_nf` is not needed; `linear_combination` handles it.)
            linear_combination hx + (x.1.1 1 * x.1.1 2) * hpar⟩ : D), x.1.1 2)
      invFun := fun u => ⟨back u, back0 u⟩
      left_inv := by
        intro x
        apply Subtype.ext
        apply Subtype.ext
        apply fin3_ext'
        · dsimp [back]
          exact x.2.symm
        · dsimp [back]
          simp
        · dsimp [back]
      right_inv := by
        intro u
        rcases u with ⟨d,c⟩
        apply Prod.ext
        · apply Subtype.ext
          dsimp [back]
          simp
        · dsimp [back] }
  -- for a fixed `d`, invariance under moves `1` then `2` says invariance
  -- under one translation of the line.
  have inner (d : D) : (∑ c : ZMod p, f (back (d,c))) = 0 := by
    have d0 : (d.1 : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := by
      intro hdz
      have hd := d.2
      have ha2 : a ^ 2 ≠ (0 : ZMod p) := pow_ne_zero _ ha
      -- the equation `d^2=-a^2` forbids `d=0`
      rw [hdz] at hd
      have : a ^ 2 = (0 : ZMod p) := by
        linear_combination hd
      exact ha2 this
    let step : ZMod p := -(2 : ZMod p) * d.1
    have step0 : step ≠ 0 := by
      dsimp [step]
      exact mul_ne_zero (neg_ne_zero.mpr htwo) d0
    have trans (c : ZMod p) :
        f (back (d, c + step)) = f (back (d,c)) := by
      -- compute the composition explicitly on this line
      have hcomp : vieta2 (vieta1 (back (d,c))) = back (d, c + step) := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        apply fin3_ext'
        · simp [back]
        · simp [back, step, hpar] <;> ring
        · simp [back, step, hpar] <;> ring
      rw [← hcomp]
      exact (hf _ (2 : Fin 3)).trans (hf _ (1 : Fin 3))
    exact zmod_sum_translate_zero hp step step0
      (fun c => f (back (d,c))) trans
  -- Reindex the slice by `(d,c)` and sum the just computed zero sums.
  calc
    (∑ x : {x : MarkoffTriple p // x.1 0 = a}, f x.1) =
        ∑ u : D × ZMod p, f (back u) := by
          exact Fintype.sum_equiv e _ _ (by
            intro x
            have hx := e.left_inv x
            exact congrArg (fun y : {x : MarkoffTriple p // x.1 0 = a} => f y.1) hx.symm)
    _ = ∑ d : D, ∑ c : ZMod p, f (back (d,c)) := by
          exact Fintype.sum_prod_type _
    _ = 0 := by simp [inner]


/-- The other parabolic sign is the same calculation, carried over by
`neg01`.  Notice that this symmetry is only used for a sum; it is not assumed
to be an extra edge of the graph. -/
lemma sum_fibre_parabolic_neg_zero {p : ℕ} [NeZero p]
    [Fintype (MarkoffTriple p)] (hp : Nat.Prime p)
    (a : ZMod p) (ha : a ≠ 0) (htwo : (2 : ZMod p) ≠ 0)
    (hpar : (3 : ZMod p) * a = -(2 : ZMod p))
    (f : MarkoffTriple p → ZMod p)
    (hf : ∀ (x : MarkoffTriple p) (i : Fin 3), f (vieta i x) = f x) :
    (∑ x : {x : MarkoffTriple p // x.1 0 = a}, f x.1) = 0 := by
  classical
  let f' : MarkoffTriple p → ZMod p := fun x => f (neg01 x)
  have hf' : ∀ (x : MarkoffTriple p) (i : Fin 3),
      f' (vieta i x) = f' x := by
    intro x i
    dsimp [f']
    rw [neg01_vieta]
    exact hf (neg01 x) i
  have hpar' : (3 : ZMod p) * (-a) = 2 := by
    linear_combination -(hpar)
  have hpos : (∑ y : {x : MarkoffTriple p // x.1 0 = -a},
       f' y.1) = 0 :=
    sum_fibre_parabolic_pos_zero hp (-a) (neg_ne_zero.mpr ha)
      htwo hpar' f' hf'
  let e : {x : MarkoffTriple p // x.1 0 = a} ≃
          {x : MarkoffTriple p // x.1 0 = -a} :=
    { toFun := fun x => ⟨neg01 x.1, by simp [x.2]⟩
      invFun := fun y => ⟨neg01 y.1, by
        simpa using congrArg Neg.neg y.2⟩
      left_inv := by
        intro x
        apply Subtype.ext
        exact neg01_invol x.1
      right_inv := by
        intro x
        apply Subtype.ext
        exact neg01_invol x.1 }
  calc
    (∑ x : {x : MarkoffTriple p // x.1 0 = a}, f x.1) =
        ∑ y : {x : MarkoffTriple p // x.1 0 = -a}, f' y.1 := by
          exact Fintype.sum_equiv e _ _ (by
            intro x
            simp [e, f'])
    _ = 0 := hpos

end LeanEval.Combinatorics

theorem dvd_card_connectedComponent_markoffGraph {p : ℕ} (hp : Nat.Prime p) (hgt : 3 < p) :

  classical
  intro c
  refine c.ind ?_
  intro v
  -- The support of a component is the reachable class of its base point.
  let e₁ : (markoffGraph p).connectedComponentMk v ≃
      { w : MarkoffTriple p // (markoffGraph p).Reachable v w } :=
    { toFun := fun w =>
        ⟨w.1, (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.eq.mp w.2).symm⟩
      invFun := fun w =>
        ⟨w.1, SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.eq.mpr w.2.symm⟩
      left_inv := by
        intro w
        apply Subtype.ext
        rfl
      right_inv := by
        intro w
        apply Subtype.ext
        rfl }
  let e₂ : { w : MarkoffTriple p // (markoffGraph p).Reachable v w } ≃
      { w : MarkoffTriple p // ∃ L : List (Fin 3),
          LeanEval.Combinatorics.applyVietas L v = w } :=
    Equiv.subtypeEquivRight (fun w =>
      LeanEval.Combinatorics.reachable_iff_word v w)
  have hc : Nat.card ((markoffGraph p).connectedComponentMk v) =
      Nat.card { w : MarkoffTriple p // ∃ L : List (Fin 3),
        LeanEval.Combinatorics.applyVietas L v = w } :=
    Nat.card_congr (e₁.trans e₂)
  rw [hc]
  -- A convenient last reduction is to a finite-field statement about invariant
  -- functions on the Markoff surface.  It does not mention components or paths.
  letI : NeZero p := ⟨hp.ne_zero⟩
  letI : Fintype (Fin 3 → ZMod p) := inferInstance
  letI : Fintype (MarkoffTriple p) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  -- The genuinely difficult input is the finite--field orbit theorem.  Unlike
  -- the constancy on a quadratic fibre (whose fibre has one or two roots), it
  -- uses all three moves at once.  We keep it in its useful ``test
  -- function'' form: every function invariant under all moves has zero
  -- total in the prime field.  This is precisely the finite--field part of
  -- Chen's theorem; no assertion about separate two--coordinate fibres is
  -- strong enough to imply it.
  have annihilate :
      ∀ f : MarkoffTriple p → ZMod p,
        (∀ (x : MarkoffTriple p) (i : Fin 3),
          f (LeanEval.Combinatorics.vieta i x) = f x) →
        (∑ x : MarkoffTriple p, f x) = 0 := by
    intro f hf
    letI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩

    -- quadratic fibres.  These are useful consequences, but not the
    -- vanishing assertion (the global orbit input is still needed below).
    have tailConst : ∀ (x y : MarkoffTriple p),
        x.1 1 = y.1 1 → x.1 2 = y.1 2 → f x = f y := by
      intro x y h1 h2
      rcases LeanEval.Combinatorics.eq_or_vieta0_of_tail x y h1 h2 with h | h
      · simp [h]
      · subst y
        simpa using (hf x (0 : Fin 3)).symm
    have sideConst : ∀ (x y : MarkoffTriple p),
        x.1 0 = y.1 0 → x.1 2 = y.1 2 → f x = f y := by
      intro x y h0 h2
      rcases LeanEval.Combinatorics.eq_or_vieta1_of_side x y h0 h2 with h | h
      · simp [h]
      · subst y
        simpa using (hf x (1 : Fin 3)).symm
    have headConst : ∀ (x y : MarkoffTriple p),
        x.1 0 = y.1 0 → x.1 1 = y.1 1 → f x = f y := by
      intro x y h0 h1
      rcases LeanEval.Combinatorics.eq_or_vieta2_of_head x y h0 h1 with h | h
      · simp [h]
      · subst y
        simpa using (hf x (2 : Fin 3)).symm
    have hword :
        ∀ (w : List (Fin 3)) (x : MarkoffTriple p),
          f (LeanEval.Combinatorics.applyVietas w x) = f x :=
      LeanEval.Combinatorics.invariant_applyVietas f hf
    have hthree : (3 : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := by
      intro hz
      have hp3 : p ∣ 3 :=
        (CharP.cast_eq_zero_iff (ZMod p) p 3).1 hz
      have hp_le : p ≤ 3 := Nat.le_of_dvd (by decide) hp3
      exact (Nat.not_le_of_gt hgt) hp_le
    -- First remove the two parabolic slices.  On these slices one really
    -- sees a cyclic additive orbit of length `p`: if `3*x₀=2`, write the
    -- other coordinates as `(c+d,c)`.  The equation forces `d^2=-x₀^2`,
    -- whence `d≠0`, and the moves `1,2` translate `c` by `-2*d`.
    -- The (checked) calculation is `sum_fibre_parabolic_pos_zero` above.
    have htwo : (2 : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := by
      intro hz
      have hp2 : p ∣ 2 :=
        (CharP.cast_eq_zero_iff (ZMod p) p 2).1 hz
      have hle : p ≤ 2 := Nat.le_of_dvd (by decide) hp2
      exact (Nat.not_le_of_gt (lt_trans (by decide : 2 < 3) hgt)) hle
    let Q : ZMod p → Prop :=
      fun a => ((3 : ZMod p) * a)^2 = (4 : ZMod p)
    let slice : ZMod p → ZMod p :=
      fun a => ∑ x : {x : MarkoffTriple p // x.1 0 = a}, f x.1
    have para_zero : ∀ a : ZMod p, Q a → slice a = 0 := by
      intro a hqa
      have fac : ((3 : ZMod p) * a - 2) *
            ((3 : ZMod p) * a + 2) = 0 := by
        dsimp [Q] at hqa
        linear_combination hqa
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp fac with hplus | hminus
      · have hpa : (3 : ZMod p) * a = 2 := sub_eq_zero.mp hplus
        have ha : a ≠ 0 := by
          intro h0
          rw [h0] at hpa
          have : (2 : ZMod p) = 0 := by
            simpa using hpa.symm
          exact htwo this
        exact LeanEval.Combinatorics.sum_fibre_parabolic_pos_zero
            hp a ha htwo hpa f hf
      · have hpa : (3 : ZMod p) * a = -(2 : ZMod p) := by
          linear_combination hminus
        have ha : a ≠ 0 := by
          intro h0
          rw [h0] at hpa
          have : (2 : ZMod p) = 0 := by
            -- now `0=-2`
            linear_combination hpa
          exact htwo this
        exact LeanEval.Combinatorics.sum_fibre_parabolic_neg_zero
            hp a ha htwo hpa f hf
    have all_slices :
        (∑ x : MarkoffTriple p, f x) =
          ∑ a : ZMod p,
            (∑ x : {x : MarkoffTriple p // x.1 0 = a}, f x.1) := by
      let E := Equiv.sigmaFiberEquiv
        (fun x : MarkoffTriple p => (x.1 0 : ZMod p))
      have he := Equiv.sum_comp E f
      -- `E ⟨a,x⟩` is just `x`.
      change (∑ (z : (a : ZMod p) ×
          {x : MarkoffTriple p // x.1 0 = a}), f (E z)) =
            (∑ x : MarkoffTriple p, f x) at he
      have he' :
          (∑ z : (a : ZMod p) ×
             {x : MarkoffTriple p // x.1 0 = a}, f z.2.1) =
            (∑ x : MarkoffTriple p, f x) := by
        simpa [E, Equiv.sigmaFiberEquiv] using he
      rw [Fintype.sum_sigma (fun z : (a : ZMod p) ×
          {x : MarkoffTriple p // x.1 0 = a} => f z.2.1)] at he'
      exact he'.symm
    -- Thus the still anisotropic (semisimple) rotations are the only
    -- remaining part of the orbit theorem.  Stating it after the above
    -- reindexing means the parabolic order-`p` calculation will not have
    -- to be mixed with that case.

        (∑ a : ZMod p, if Q a then 0 else slice a) = 0 := by
      -- A useful elementary divergence on the smooth affine surface closes
      -- the semisimple part as well.  Its coefficient only uses the *other*
      -- two coordinates, hence is unchanged by the corresponding flip.
      let k : ZMod p → ZMod p → ZMod p :=
        fun b c => -(1 / ((3 : ZMod p) * b * c))
      let t0 : MarkoffTriple p → ZMod p := fun x =>
        k (x.1 1) (x.1 2) *
          ((2 : ZMod p) * x.1 0 - (3 : ZMod p) * x.1 1 * x.1 2)
      let t1 : MarkoffTriple p → ZMod p := fun x =>
        k (x.1 0) (x.1 2) *
          ((2 : ZMod p) * x.1 1 - (3 : ZMod p) * x.1 0 * x.1 2)
      let t2 : MarkoffTriple p → ZMod p := fun x =>
        k (x.1 0) (x.1 1) *
          ((2 : ZMod p) * x.1 2 - (3 : ZMod p) * x.1 0 * x.1 1)
      have odd0 (x : MarkoffTriple p) :
          t0 (LeanEval.Combinatorics.vieta0 x) = - t0 x := by
        simp [t0, k, sub_eq_add_neg]
        ring
      have odd1 (x : MarkoffTriple p) :
          t1 (LeanEval.Combinatorics.vieta1 x) = - t1 x := by
        simp [t1, k, sub_eq_add_neg]
        ring
      have odd2 (x : MarkoffTriple p) :
          t2 (LeanEval.Combinatorics.vieta2 x) = - t2 x := by
        simp [t2, k, sub_eq_add_neg]
        ring
      have sum_odd (j : Fin 3)
          (t : MarkoffTriple p → ZMod p)
          (hodd : ∀ x, t (LeanEval.Combinatorics.vieta j x) = - t x) :
          (∑ x : MarkoffTriple p, f x * t x) = 0 := by
        let ee : MarkoffTriple p ≃ MarkoffTriple p :=
          { toFun := fun x => LeanEval.Combinatorics.vieta j x
            invFun := fun x => LeanEval.Combinatorics.vieta j x
            left_inv := LeanEval.Combinatorics.vieta_invol j
            right_inv := LeanEval.Combinatorics.vieta_invol j }
        have he := Equiv.sum_comp ee (fun x : MarkoffTriple p => f x * t x)
        have he' : -(∑ x : MarkoffTriple p, f x * t x) =
            (∑ x : MarkoffTriple p, f x * t x) := by
          calc
            -(∑ x : MarkoffTriple p, f x * t x) =
                ∑ x : MarkoffTriple p, -(f x * t x) := by
                  simp
            _ = ∑ x : MarkoffTriple p, f (ee x) * t (ee x) := by
                  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl

        exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hh).resolve_left htwo

      have s1 : (∑ x : MarkoffTriple p, f x * t1 x) = 0 :=
        sum_odd (1 : Fin 3) t1 (by simpa using odd1)
      have s2 : (∑ x : MarkoffTriple p, f x * t2 x) = 0 :=
        sum_odd (2 : Fin 3) t2 (by simpa using odd2)
      -- The last local calculation is the Jacobian/divergence identity on a
      -- smooth point.  With `k b c = -1/(3*b*c)`, its three summands add
      -- to one; if a coordinate vanishes only the opposite term is left.
      have tone (x : MarkoffTriple p) : t0 x + t1 x + t2 x = 1 := by
        -- expand the rational functions.  On a smooth Markoff point either all
        -- coordinates are nonzero, or exactly one is zero.  In the latter case
        -- the summand opposite that coordinate is identically one.
        have hx := x.2.2
        by_cases ha0 : x.1 0 = (0 : ZMod p)
        · -- the first coordinate is zero; the other two cannot vanish.
          have hb0 : x.1 1 ≠ (0 : ZMod p) := by
            intro hb
            have hc2 : x.1 2 ^ 2 = (0 : ZMod p) := by
              -- after setting the first two coordinates to zero the equation is `c^2=0`
              simpa [ha0, hb] using hx
            have hc : x.1 2 = (0 : ZMod p) := (sq_eq_zero_iff).mp hc2
            apply x.2.1
            apply LeanEval.Combinatorics.fin3_ext'
            · simp [ha0]
            · simp [hb]
            · simp [hc]
          have hc0 : x.1 2 ≠ (0 : ZMod p) := by
            intro hc
            have hb2 : x.1 1 ^ 2 = (0 : ZMod p) := by
              simpa [ha0, hc] using hx
            have hb : x.1 1 = (0 : ZMod p) := (sq_eq_zero_iff).mp hb2
            exact hb0 hb
          -- only the first summand (whose other coordinates are `1,2`) survives.
          -- direct field cancellation is quite robust with `field_simp`.
          dsimp [t0, t1, t2, k]
          simp [ha0]
          field_simp
        · by_cases hb0 : x.1 1 = (0 : ZMod p)
          · -- the second coordinate is zero
            have hc0 : x.1 2 ≠ (0 : ZMod p) := by
              intro hc
              have ha2 : x.1 0 ^ 2 = (0 : ZMod p) := by
                simpa [hb0, hc] using hx
              have ha : x.1 0 = (0 : ZMod p) := (sq_eq_zero_iff).mp ha2
              exact ha0 ha
            dsimp [t0, t1, t2, k]
            simp [hb0]
            field_simp
          · by_cases hc0 : x.1 2 = (0 : ZMod p)
            · -- the third coordinate is zero
              dsimp [t0, t1, t2, k]
              simp [hc0]
              field_simp
            · -- all three coordinates are nonzero.  Clear denominators and
              -- use the Markoff equation.
              dsimp [t0, t1, t2, k]
              field_simp
              -- after clearing denominators the identity is precisely the
              -- Markoff equation multiplied by a scalar.
              linear_combination (-(2 : ZMod p)) * hx

        calc
          (∑ x : MarkoffTriple p, f x) =

                apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
                intro x hx
                rw [← mul_add, ← mul_add, tone x]
                simp
          _ = 0 := by
            rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib, s0, s1, s2]
            simp
      have hslice0 : (∑ a : ZMod p, slice a) = 0 := by
        rw [← all_slices]
        exact hzall
      calc
        (∑ a : ZMod p, if Q a then 0 else slice a) =
            ∑ a : ZMod p, slice a := by
              apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
              intro a ha
              by_cases hq : Q a
              · simp [hq, para_zero a hq]
              · simp [hq]
        _ = 0 := hslice0
    calc
      (∑ x : MarkoffTriple p, f x) = ∑ a : ZMod p, slice a := by
        simpa [slice] using all_slices
      _ = ∑ a : ZMod p, (if Q a then 0 else slice a) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro a ha
        by_cases hq : Q a
        · simp [hq, para_zero a hq]
        · simp [hq]
      _ = 0 := core

  let R : MarkoffTriple p → Prop :=
    fun w => (markoffGraph p).Reachable v w
  have stepReach (x : MarkoffTriple p) (i : Fin 3) :
      (markoffGraph p).Reachable x (LeanEval.Combinatorics.vieta i x) :=
    (LeanEval.Combinatorics.reachable_iff_word x _).2
      ⟨[i], by simp [LeanEval.Combinatorics.applyVietas]⟩
  have preserve (x : MarkoffTriple p) (i : Fin 3) :
      R (LeanEval.Combinatorics.vieta i x) ↔ R x := by
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact h.trans (stepReach x i).symm
    · intro h
      exact h.trans (stepReach x i)
  let f : MarkoffTriple p → ZMod p :=
    fun x => if R x then 1 else 0
  have finv : ∀ (x : MarkoffTriple p) (i : Fin 3),
      f (LeanEval.Combinatorics.vieta i x) = f x := by
    intro x i
    dsimp [f]
    by_cases hx : R x
    · have hx' : R (LeanEval.Combinatorics.vieta i x) :=
        (preserve x i).2 hx
      simp [hx, hx']
    · have hx' : ¬ R (LeanEval.Combinatorics.vieta i x) := by
        intro hh
        exact hx ((preserve x i).1 hh)
      simp [hx, hx']
  have sz : (∑ x : MarkoffTriple p, f x) = 0 := annihilate f finv
  have castzero :
      ( (Fintype.card {x : MarkoffTriple p // R x} : ℕ) : ZMod p) = 0 := by
    classical
    have hsumb :
        (∑ x ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (MarkoffTriple p)),
            if R x then (1 : ZMod p) else 0) =
          ( ({x ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (MarkoffTriple p)) | R x}.card : ℕ) : ZMod p) :=
      Finset.sum_boole R _
    have hz :
        ( ( {x ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (MarkoffTriple p)) | R x}.card : ℕ) : ZMod p) = 0 := by
      -- the sum here is exactly the sum of the invariant indicator
      have hh :
          (∑ x ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (MarkoffTriple p)),
              if R x then (1 : ZMod p) else 0) = 0 := by
        simpa [f] using sz
      exact hsumb.symm.trans hh
    have hcard :
        Fintype.card {x : MarkoffTriple p // R x} =
          {x ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (MarkoffTriple p)) | R x}.card := by
      classical
      simpa using (Fintype.card_subtype R)
    simpa [hcard] using hz
  have divR : p ∣ Nat.card {x : MarkoffTriple p // R x} := by
    rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
    exact (CharP.cast_eq_zero_iff (ZMod p) p _).1 castzero
  have ew : { w : MarkoffTriple p // R w } ≃
      { w : MarkoffTriple p // ∃ L : List (Fin 3),
          LeanEval.Combinatorics.applyVietas L v = w } := by
    exact e₂
  have cc2 : Nat.card { w : MarkoffTriple p // R w } =
      Nat.card { w : MarkoffTriple p // ∃ L : List (Fin 3),
          LeanEval.Combinatorics.applyVietas L v = w } :=
    Nat.card_congr ew
  rwa [cc2] at divR/-ResultProofEnd-/
/-ResultEnd-/

open LeanEval.Dynamics
open scoped ENNReal
open MeasureTheory Filter Topology Real
open Submission.Helpers

namespace Submission

theorem entropy_dimension_lyapunov (T T_inv : EucPlane → EucPlane)
    (hT_smooth : ContDiff ℝ 2 T)
    (hT_inv_smooth : ContDiff ℝ 2 T_inv)
    (hT_left : Function.LeftInverse T_inv T)
    (hT_right : Function.RightInverse T_inv T)
    (K : Set EucPlane)
    (hK_compact : IsCompact K)
    (hK_inv : T '' K = K)
    (μ : Measure EucPlane) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hμ_supp : μ Kᶜ = 0)
    (hμ_pres : MeasurePreserving T μ μ)
    (hμ_erg : Ergodic T μ) :
    kolmogorovSinaiEntropy μ T =
      (dimMeasure μ).toReal *
        harmonicMeanLyapunov
          (∫ x, lyapunovUpperAt T x ∂μ)
          (∫ x, lyapunovLowerAt T x ∂μ) / 2 := by
  classical
  by_cases hatom : ∃ x : EucPlane, μ {x} ≠ 0
  · obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hatom
    exact entropy_dimension_lyapunov_of_atom_of_ergodic
      T hT_left.injective μ hμ_pres hμ_erg hx
  · have hall : ∀ x : EucPlane, μ {x} = 0 := by
      push Not at hatom
      exact hatom
    letI : NoAtoms μ := ⟨hall⟩
    let lam1 := ∫ x, lyapunovUpperAt T x ∂μ
    let lam2 := ∫ x, lyapunovLowerAt T x ∂μ
    have hlam1 :
        lam1 = ∫ x, lyapunovUpperAt T x ∂μ := rfl
    have hlam2 :
        lam2 = ∫ x, lyapunovLowerAt T x ∂μ := rfl
    by_cases hlam1_neg : lam1 < 0
    · exact entropy_dimension_lyapunov_of_integral_upper_neg
        T T_inv hT_smooth hT_inv_smooth hT_left hT_right
          K hK_compact hK_inv μ hμ_supp hμ_pres hμ_erg
          hlam1 hlam1_neg
    have hlam1_nonneg : 0 ≤ lam1 := le_of_not_gt hlam1_neg
    by_cases hlam2_pos : 0 < lam2
    · exact entropy_dimension_lyapunov_of_integral_lower_pos
        T T_inv hT_smooth hT_inv_smooth hT_left hT_right
          K hK_compact hK_inv μ hμ_supp hμ_pres hμ_erg
          hlam2 hlam2_pos
    have hlam2_nonpos : lam2 ≤ 0 := le_of_not_gt hlam2_pos
    by_cases hzero : lam1 = 0 ∨ lam2 = 0
    · simpa [lam1, lam2] using
        (entropy_dimension_lyapunov_of_zero_exponent
          T T_inv hT_smooth hT_inv_smooth hT_left hT_right
            K hK_compact hK_inv μ hμ_supp hμ_pres hμ_erg
            hlam1 hlam2 hlam1_nonneg hlam2_nonpos hzero)
    have hlam1_pos : 0 < lam1 :=
      lt_of_le_of_ne hlam1_nonneg (fun h => hzero (Or.inl h.symm))
    have hlam2_neg : lam2 < 0 :=
      lt_of_le_of_ne hlam2_nonpos (fun h => hzero (Or.inr h))
    simpa [lam1, lam2] using
      (young_identity_of_approx_hyperbolic_bounds
        (entropy := kolmogorovSinaiEntropy μ T)
        (dim := (dimMeasure μ).toReal)
        (lam1 := lam1) (lam2 := lam2)
        ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
        (fun epsilon hepsilon =>
          kolmogorovSinaiEntropy_sub_le_dimMeasure_mul_hyperbolicRate_add
            T T_inv hT_smooth hT_inv_smooth hT_left hT_right
              K hK_compact hK_inv μ hμ_supp hμ_pres hμ_erg
              hlam1 hlam2 hlam1_pos hlam2_neg hepsilon)
        (fun epsilon hepsilon =>
          dimMeasure_mul_hyperbolicRate_sub_le_kolmogorovSinaiEntropy
            T T_inv hT_smooth hT_inv_smooth hT_left hT_right
              K hK_compact hK_inv μ hμ_supp hμ_pres hμ_erg
              hlam1 hlam2 hlam1_pos hlam2_neg hepsilon))

end Submission
