/-- The heterogeneous alphabets in `FinTM2` present no extra computing power.
Letters on scratch stacks can be represented by their finite syntactic source and state. -/
theorem computable_finTM2_nat
    (tm : Turing.FinTM2)
    (e₀ : tm.Γ tm.k₀ ≃ Bool) (e₁ : tm.Γ tm.k₁ ≃ Bool)
    (f : ℕ → ℕ)
    (runs : ∀ n, Turing.TM2Outputs tm
       ((encodeNat n).map e₀.symm)
       (some ((encodeNat (f n)).map e₁.symm))) :
    Computable f := by
  classical
  letI dK : DecidableEq tm.K := tm.kDecidableEq
  letI fk : Fintype tm.K := tm.kFin
  letI fs0 : Fintype tm.σ := tm.σFin
  letI fl0 : Fintype tm.Λ := tm.ΛFin
  letI fi0 : Fintype (tm.Γ tm.k₀) := tm.Γk₀Fin
  -- choose elementary primitive codings of the three finite sets and of the symbolic alphabet
  letI pg0 : Primcodable (tm.Γ tm.k₀) := fintPrim _
  letI pK : Primcodable tm.K := fintPrim tm.K
  letI pS : Primcodable tm.σ := fintPrim tm.σ
  letI pL : Primcodable tm.Λ := fintPrim tm.Λ
  letI ufin : Fintype (HU tm.Γ tm.k₀ tm.m) := by unfold HU; infer_instance
  letI pu : Primcodable (HU tm.Γ tm.k₀ tm.m) := fintPrim (HU tm.Γ tm.k₀ tm.m)
  -- keep typeclass search at the opaque-as-written coding rather than unfolding the sum
  letI psum : Primcodable ((tm.Γ tm.k₀) ⊕ (Fin (hall (Γ:=tm.Γ) tm.m).length × tm.σ)) := pu
  -- finite typeclasses expected by the uniform evaluator
  letI fs : Finite tm.σ := Finite.of_fintype _
  letI fl : Finite tm.Λ := Finite.of_fintype _
  letI fu : Finite (HU tm.Γ tm.k₀ tm.m) := Finite.of_fintype _

  let xi (n : ℕ) : List (tm.Γ tm.k₀) := (encodeNat n).map e₀.symm
  let yi (n : ℕ) : List (HU tm.Γ tm.k₀ tm.m) := (xi n).map (fun a => (Sum.inl a : HU tm.Γ tm.k₀ tm.m))
  let di (n : ℕ) : TM2.Cfg (fun _ : tm.K => (HU tm.Γ tm.k₀ tm.m)) tm.Λ tm.σ :=
      { l := some tm.main, var := tm.initialState,
        stk := Function.update (fun _ : tm.K => ([] : List (HU tm.Γ tm.k₀ tm.m))) tm.k₀ (yi n) }
  let cf (n : ℕ) : tm.Cfg := haltList tm ((encodeNat (f n)).map e₁.symm)

  have relin (n : ℕ) : HCfg tm.Γ tm.k₀ tm.m (initList tm (xi n)) (di n) := by
    -- the definition of `initList` is exactly this singleton update
    simpa [di, Turing.initList] using
      (hinit (Γ:=tm.Γ) (k₀:=tm.k₀) (m:=tm.m) tm.main tm.initialState (xi n))

  have lifted : ∀ n, ∃ d : TM2.Cfg (fun _ : tm.K => (HU tm.Γ tm.k₀ tm.m)) tm.Λ tm.σ,
       (∃ t : ℕ, (flip Option.bind (TM2.step (hprog tm.Γ tm.k₀ tm.m)))^[t] (di n) = some d) ∧
       HCfg tm.Γ tm.k₀ tm.m (cf n) d := by
    intro n
    have rn := runs n
    change StateTransition.EvalsTo (TM2.step tm.m)
       (initList tm (xi n)) (some (cf n)) at rn
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := rn
    obtain ⟨d, hd, rd⟩ := hiter tm.Γ tm.k₀ tm.m (relin n) t (cf n) ht
    exact ⟨d, ⟨⟨t, hd⟩, rd⟩⟩

  choose dn heval hrel using lifted
  -- The symbolic input is recursive (only a finite alphabet map is involved).
  have cxi : Computable xi := by
    dsimp [xi]
    -- maps of finite alphabets are primitive recursive
    have pe : Primrec e₀.symm := Primrec.dom_finite _
    have pm : Primrec (fun l : List Bool => l.map e₀.symm) :=
      Primrec.list_map Primrec.id (pe.comp Primrec.snd).to₂
    exact pm.to_comp.comp prim_encodeNat.to_comp
  have cy : Computable yi := by
    dsimp [yi]
    have pin : Primrec (fun a : tm.Γ tm.k₀ => (Sum.inl a : (HU tm.Γ tm.k₀ tm.m))) :=
      Primrec.dom_finite _
    have pm : Primrec (fun l : List (tm.Γ tm.k₀) =>
          l.map (fun a => (Sum.inl a : (HU tm.Γ tm.k₀ tm.m)))) :=
      Primrec.list_map Primrec.id (pin.comp Primrec.snd).to₂
    exact pm.to_comp.comp cxi

  have listU : Computable (fun n => (dn n).stk tm.k₁) := by
    apply computable_homogeneous (Γ:=(HU tm.Γ tm.k₀ tm.m)) tm.k₀ tm.k₁ tm.main tm.initialState
        (hprog tm.Γ tm.k₀ tm.m) yi cy (fun n => (dn n).stk tm.k₁) dn
    · intro n
      exact ⟨Classical.choose (heval n), by
        simpa [di] using (Classical.choose_spec (heval n))⟩
    · intro n
      have r := (hrel n).1
      -- the related target is the canonical halted configuration
      exact r.symm ▸ rfl
    · intro n; rfl

  -- Read decoded booleans; ill-coloured cells are immaterial (and never occur).
  let rd : (HU tm.Γ tm.k₀ tm.m) → Bool := fun a =>
       (hdec tm.Γ tm.k₀ tm.m tm.k₁ a).elim false e₁
  have pr : Primrec rd := Primrec.dom_finite _
  have rb : Computable (fun n => ((dn n).stk tm.k₁).map rd) := by
    have pm : Primrec (fun l : List (HU tm.Γ tm.k₀ tm.m) => l.map rd) :=
      Primrec.list_map Primrec.id (pr.comp Primrec.snd).to₂
    exact pm.to_comp.comp listU
  have enc : (fun n => ((dn n).stk tm.k₁).map rd) =
        (fun n => encodeNat (f n)) := by
    funext n
    have hh := (hrel n).2.2 tm.k₁
    have hx := congrArg (List.map (fun z : Option (tm.Γ tm.k₁) => z.elim false e₁)) hh
    -- each related stack consists of valid cells; the original halted output
    -- is the claimed list in the output alphabet
    simpa [rd, cf, Turing.haltList, List.map_map, Function.comp_def] using hx
  have outbits : Computable (fun n => encodeNat (f n)) := enc ▸ rb
  exact (prim_bitval.to_comp.comp outbits).of_eq (fun n => bitval_encode (f n))

/-- direct specialization to the mathlib structure -/
theorem TM2Computable.computable_nat {f : ℕ → ℕ}
    (h : Nonempty (TM2Computable encodeNat encodeNat f)) : Computable f := by
  classical
  rcases h with ⟨h⟩
  exact computable_finTM2_nat h.tm h.inputAlphabet h.outputAlphabet f h.outputsFun
end

end

/-! Proof-only infrastructure: a finite colorful convex hull lemma. -/
noncomputable section
open scoped BigOperators RealInnerProductSpace
open Set Filter

namespace Tverberg65

/-- At a point of a convex set minimizing its squared norm, the supporting
    linear functional points inward.  We state it for real inner product
    spaces; no closedness hypotheses are needed after a minimum is known. -/
lemma inner_ge_of_min_on_convex {V : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V]
    {C : Set V} (hC : Convex ℝ C) {p : V} (hp : p ∈ C)
    (hmin : ∀ q ∈ C, ‖p‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖q‖ ^ 2)
    {q : V} (hq : q ∈ C) : ‖p‖ ^ 2 ≤ @inner ℝ V _ p q := by
  -- Move a small positive distance from `p` towards `q`.  If the displayed
  -- inequality failed the squared norm would go down.
  by_contra hn
  have hlt : @inner ℝ V _ p q < ‖p‖ ^ 2 := lt_of_not_ge hn
  let δ : ℝ := ‖p‖ ^ 2 - @inner ℝ V _ p q

/-- Finite colorful Carathéodory in the exact dimension needed below.
There is one color class for each of `finrank V + 1` indices and all

theorem colorful_zero
    {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] [Fintype κ] [Nonempty κ]
    (X : ι → κ → V)
    (hcard : Fintype.card ι = Module.finrank ℝ V + 1)
    (hzero : ∀ i, (0:V) ∈ convexHull ℝ (Set.range (X i))) :
    ∃ g : ι → κ, (0:V) ∈ convexHull ℝ (Set.range (fun i => X i (g i))) := by

  have hcomp : IsCompact U := by
    dsimp [U]
    apply isCompact_iUnion
    intro g
    exact (Set.finite_range _).isCompact_convexHull ℝ

    let g : ι → κ := fun _ => Classical.choice ‹Nonempty κ›
    let i : ι := Classical.choice ‹Nonempty ι›
    have hx : X i (g i) ∈ S g := by
      dsimp [S]
      exact subset_convexHull ℝ _ (Set.mem_range_self _)
    exact ⟨_, Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨g, hx⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨p, hpU, hpmin⟩ := hcomp.exists_isMinOn hne
      ((continuous_norm.pow 2).continuousOn)
  -- Choose the colorful simplex attaining this minimizing point.
  rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp hpU with ⟨g, hp⟩
  -- If the point were nonzero we get a missing color on a supporting face.

  have hp0 : p ≠ (0:V) := by
    intro hpz
    apply hcontra
    exact ⟨g, hpz ▸ hp⟩
  let c : ℝ := ‖p‖ ^ 2
  have hc : 0 < c := by dsimp [c]; positivity
  have hminS : ∀ z ∈ S g, ‖p‖^2 ≤ ‖z‖^2 := by
    intro z hz
    exact hpmin (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨g, hz⟩)
  have hsupport : ∀ z ∈ S g, c ≤ @inner ℝ V _ p z := by
    intro z hz
    dsimp [c]
    exact inner_ge_of_min_on_convex (convex_convexHull ℝ _) hp hminS hz

  -- vertices.  Positive coefficients ensure all these vertices lie on the
  -- supporting hyperplane.

  have hfind : ∀ a : α, ∃ i : ι, z a = X i (g i) := by
    intro a
    rcases hzS (Set.mem_range_self a) with ⟨i, hi⟩

  have hzinner : ∀ a : α, @inner ℝ V _ p (z a) = c := by
    intro a
    have hge : ∀ a : α, c ≤ @inner ℝ V _ p (z a) := by
      intro b

        have := hzS (Set.mem_range_self b)

      intro b

  -- affine independent family it contains has strictly fewer than the

    intro heq

      rw [← htop]

    change (0:V) ∈ AffineSubspace.mk' p (LinearMap.ker L) at h0mem
    have hzker : L (0 - p) = 0 := by
      simpa [AffineSubspace.mem_mk', vsub_eq_sub, LinearMap.mem_ker] using h0mem
    have : c = 0 := by
      simpa [LinearMap.map_sub, hL, c, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq] using hzker
    exact (ne_of_gt hc) this

    rw [hcard]
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne hlecard hnecard
  have hnotsurj : ¬ Function.Surjective col := by
    intro hs
    exact (not_le_of_gt hltα) (Fintype.card_le_of_surjective col hs)
  -- pick the missing color
  classical
  simp only [Function.Surjective] at hnotsurj
  push_neg at hnotsurj
  rcases hnotsurj with ⟨k, hk⟩
  -- Some point of that color is on the other side of the hyperplane:
  -- otherwise its whole (strict) convex hull would be on the positive side,
  -- whereas its hull contains zero.
  have hxchoice : ∃ b : κ, @inner ℝ V _ p (X k b) ≤ 0 := by
    by_contra hh
    push_neg at hh
    let T : Set V := {v | 0 < @inner ℝ V _ p v}
    have hTconv : Convex ℝ T := by
      intro u hu v hv a b ha hb hab
      change 0 < @inner ℝ V _ p (a • u + b • v)
      have hu' : 0 < @inner ℝ V _ p u := hu
      have hv' : 0 < @inner ℝ V _ p v := hv
      rw [inner_add_right, inner_smul_right, inner_smul_right]

        simp [hb1]
        exact hv'
      · have ha' : 0 < a := lt_of_le_of_ne ha (Ne.symm ha0)

        have h2 : 0 ≤ b * @inner ℝ V _ p v := mul_nonneg hb (le_of_lt hv')

      rintro _ ⟨b, rfl⟩
      exact hh b

      convexHull_min hrange hTconv
    have hzT := hhull (hzero k)
    change (0:ℝ) < @inner ℝ V _ p (0:V) at hzT
    simp at hzT
  rcases hxchoice with ⟨b, hb⟩
  -- Replace the absent color with this vertex; all supporting vertices, and
  -- hence `p`, are still in the new colorful simplex.
  let g' : ι → κ := fun i => if i = k then b else g i
  have hgcol (a : α) : g' (col a) = g (col a) := by
    dsimp [g']
    split_ifs with h
    · exact False.elim ((hk a) h)
    · rfl
  have hza : ∀ a : α, z a ∈ S g' := by
    intro a
    dsimp [S]
    apply subset_convexHull ℝ _
    refine ⟨col a, ?_⟩
    change X (col a) (g' (col a)) = z a
    rw [hgcol a]
    exact (hcol a).symm

    have hs := (convex_convexHull ℝ (Set.range (fun i => X i (g' i)))).sum_mem

      (fun i hi => le_of_lt (hwpos i)) hwsum
      (fun i hi => hza i)

  have hxb : X k b ∈ S g' := by
    dsimp [S]
    apply subset_convexHull ℝ _
    refine ⟨k, ?_⟩
    simp [g']

    intro y hy
    exact hpmin (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨g', hy⟩)

abbrev TVSpace (d : ℕ) := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)
abbrev LiftSpace (r d : ℕ) := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (r-1) × Fin (d+1))

def aug {d n : ℕ} (f : Fin n → TVSpace d) (j : Fin n) (b : Fin (d+1)) : ℝ :=
  if h : b.val < d then f j ⟨b.val, h⟩ else 1

@[simp] lemma aug_last {d n} (f : Fin n → TVSpace d) (j) :
    aug f j (Fin.last d) = 1 := by
  simp [aug, Fin.last, Nat.lt_irrefl]

lemma sub_lt_self_pos {r : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) : r - 1 < r := by omega

def ca {r : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (a : Fin (r-1)) : Fin r :=
  ⟨a.val, lt_trans a.isLt (sub_lt_self_pos hr)⟩
def klast {r : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) : Fin r := ⟨r-1, sub_lt_self_pos hr⟩

@[simp] lemma ca_val {r} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (a : Fin (r-1)) : (ca hr a).val = a.val := rfl
@[simp] lemma klast_val {r} (hr : 1 ≤ r) : (klast hr).val = r-1 := rfl
lemma ca_lt {r} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (a : Fin (r-1)) : (ca hr a).val < r-1 := a.isLt
lemma klast_not_lt {r} (hr : 1 ≤ r) : ¬ (klast hr).val < r-1 := by simp
lemma eq_klast_of_not_lt {r} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (k : Fin r)
    (h : ¬ k.val < r-1) : k = klast hr := by
  apply Fin.ext
  dsimp [klast]
  omega
lemma ca_inj {r} (hr : 1 ≤ r) {a a' : Fin (r-1)} :
    ca hr a = ca hr a' ↔ a = a' := by
  constructor
  · intro h; exact Fin.ext (Fin.mk.inj_iff.mp h)
  · exact congrArg _

/-- The tensor-like Sarkaria lifting; at a short row only the matching color
has `aug`, while the last color has its negative. -/
def liftPt {d r n : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (f : Fin n → TVSpace d)
    (j : Fin n) (k : Fin r) : LiftSpace r d :=
  WithLp.toLp 2 (fun q : Fin (r-1) × Fin (d+1) =>
    if hk : k.val < r-1 then
      if q.1.val = k.val then aug f j q.2 else 0
    else -(aug f j q.2))

@[simp] lemma liftPt_apply {d r n} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (f : Fin n → TVSpace d)
    (j : Fin n) (k : Fin r) (a : Fin (r-1)) (b : Fin (d+1)) :
    liftPt hr f j k (a,b) =
      if hk : k.val < r-1 then
        if a.val = k.val then aug f j b else 0
      else -(aug f j b) := by rfl

/-- Every color class of the lifting contains zero: average all `r` colors
for the same original point. -/
lemma zero_in_lift_color {d r n : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r)

          (if k = klast hr then -(aug f j b) else 0) := by
      by_cases hk : k.val < r-1

        · have eqk : k = ca hr a := by apply Fin.ext; exact he.symm

            intro h
            have e := congrArg Fin.val h
            exact he e.symm

            intro h
            have e := congrArg Fin.val h
            dsimp [klast] at e

    rw [Finset.affineCombination_eq_linear_combination _ _ _ hws]

  rw [convexHull_range_eq_exists_affineCombination]
  exact ⟨Finset.univ, w, (by intro i hi; dsimp [w]; positivity), hws, hv⟩

            (if g j = klast hr then w j * aug f j b else 0)) := by
              apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
              intro j hj
              exact hp j
      _ = (∑ j ∈ s, (if g j = ca hr a then w j * aug f j b else 0)) -
            (∑ j ∈ s, (if g j = klast hr then w j * aug f j b else 0)) := by
              rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      _ = _ := by
        -- filtering the old support is exactly a color fiber
        simp [fiber, Finset.sum_filter]

  have htot_ca (a : Fin (r-1)) : tot (ca hr a) = t0 := by
    have H : (∑ j ∈ fiber (ca hr a), w j * aug f j (Fin.last d)) -
          (∑ j ∈ fiber (klast hr), w j * aug f j (Fin.last d)) = 0 := by
      rw [← hsplit a (Fin.last d)]
      exact hcoord a (Fin.last d)
    simp at H
    dsimp [tot, t0]
    linarith

  let bi (b : Fin d) : Fin (d+1) :=
    ⟨b.val, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt b.isLt⟩
  have aug_b (j : Fin n) (b : Fin d) : aug f j (bi b) = f j b := by
    dsimp [aug, bi]
    simp [b.isLt]
  have hvec_ca (a : Fin (r-1)) : vec (ca hr a) = vec (klast hr) := by
    apply PiLp.ext
    intro b
    have H : (∑ j ∈ fiber (ca hr a), w j * aug f j (bi b)) -
          (∑ j ∈ fiber (klast hr), w j * aug f j (bi b)) = 0 := by
      rw [← hsplit a (bi b)]
      exact hcoord a (bi b)
    simp only [aug_b] at H
    have H' : (∑ j ∈ fiber (ca hr a), w j * f j b) =
        (∑ j ∈ fiber (klast hr), w j * f j b) := sub_eq_zero.mp H
    dsimp [vec]
    simp only [WithLp.ofLp_sum, Finset.sum_apply]
    exact H'

  have k_cases (k : Fin r) : k = klast hr ∨
       ∃ a : Fin (r-1), k = ca hr a := by
    by_cases hk : k.val < r-1
    · right
      exact ⟨⟨k.val, hk⟩, by apply Fin.ext; rfl⟩
    · left
      exact eq_klast_of_not_lt hr k hk
  have htot_all (k : Fin r) : tot k = t0 := by
    rcases k_cases k with h | ⟨a, h⟩
    · simp [h, t0]
    · simpa [h] using htot_ca a
  have hvec_all (k : Fin r) : vec k = vec (klast hr) := by
    rcases k_cases k with h | ⟨a, h⟩
    · simp [h]
    · simpa [h] using hvec_ca a
  have hsumtot : (∑ k : Fin r, tot k) = 1 := by
    -- each original index occurs in one and only one filtered fiber
    calc
      (∑ k : Fin r, tot k) =
          ∑ k : Fin r, ∑ j ∈ s, (if g j = k then w j else 0) := by
            simp [tot, fiber, Finset.sum_filter]
      _ = ∑ j ∈ s, ∑ k : Fin r, (if g j = k then w j else 0) := by
            rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      _ = ∑ j ∈ s, w j := by simp
      _ = 1 := hws

  have ht0_nonneg : 0 ≤ t0 := by
    dsimp [t0, tot]
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg (by
      intro j hj
      exact hw0 j ((Finset.mem_filter.mp ((show j ∈ fiber (klast hr) from hj))).1))
  have ht0_ne : t0 ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    have H := hsumtot
    simp [htot_all, hz] at H
  have ht0_pos : 0 < t0 := lt_of_le_of_ne ht0_nonneg (Ne.symm ht0_ne)

  -- the normalized weights in any fiber give its common barycentre
  have hconv (k : Fin r) :
      (∑ j ∈ fiber k, (t0⁻¹ * w j) • f j) ∈
        convexHull ℝ (f '' {j : Fin n | g j = k}) := by
    refine (convex_convexHull ℝ _).sum_mem ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro j hj
      exact mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (inv_pos.mpr ht0_pos))
        (hw0 j ((Finset.mem_filter.mp ((show j ∈ fiber k from hj))).1))
    · calc
        (∑ j ∈ fiber k, t0⁻¹ * w j) =
            t0⁻¹ * (∑ j ∈ fiber k, w j) := by
              rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        _ = t0⁻¹ * tot k := by rfl
        _ = t0⁻¹ * t0 := by rw [htot_all k]
        _ = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ ht0_ne
    · intro j hj
      apply subset_convexHull ℝ _
      exact ⟨j, by
        change g j = k
        exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp ((show j ∈ fiber k from hj))).2, rfl⟩
  let x : TVSpace d := t0⁻¹ • vec (klast hr)
  refine ⟨(fun k => {j : Fin n | g j = k}), ?_, ?_, x, ?_⟩
  · intro i k hne
    refine Set.disjoint_left.mpr ?_
    intro j hj hj'
    change g j = i at hj
    change g j = k at hj'
    exact hne (hj.symm.trans hj')
  · ext j
    constructor
    · intro hj
      trivial
    · intro hj
      have hmem : j ∈ ({j : Fin n | g j = g j} : Set (Fin n)) := rfl
      exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨g j, hmem⟩
  · intro k
    have heq : x = ∑ j ∈ fiber k, (t0⁻¹ * w j) • f j := by
      change t0⁻¹ • vec (klast hr) = _
      calc
        t0⁻¹ • vec (klast hr) = t0⁻¹ • vec k := by rw [hvec_all k]
        _ = _ := by
          dsimp [vec]
          simp [Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul]
    rw [heq]
    exact hconv k

end Tverberg65

namespace LeanEval.Combinatorics.Tverberg

/-!
# Tverberg's theorem

`tverberg_theorem`: any `(r-1)(d+1)+1` points in `ℝ^d` can be partitioned into
`r` parts whose convex hulls share a common point. Trusted helper
`HasTverbergPartition` (non-hole). Mathlib has Radon's theorem (the `r = 2`
case) but not Tverberg.
Category-(b) candidate from §169 of the Knill survey.
-/

open scoped BigOperators

/-- Euclidean `ℝ^d`. -/
abbrev Space (d : ℕ) := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)

/-- An `r`-part Tverberg partition: disjoint parts covering all indices whose
image convex hulls share a common point. -/
def HasTverbergPartition {d r n : ℕ} (f : Fin n → Space d) : Prop :=
  ∃ parts : Fin r → Set (Fin n),
    (∀ i j : Fin r, i ≠ j → Disjoint (parts i) (parts j)) ∧
    (⋃ i : Fin r, parts i) = Set.univ ∧
    ∃ x : Space d, ∀ i : Fin r, x ∈ convexHull ℝ (f '' parts i)



end LeanEval.Combinatorics.Tverberg

open LeanEval.Combinatorics.Tverberg
open scoped BigOperators
/-ResultDefinitionsBegin-/
/-ResultProofDefinitionsBegin-/
/-ResultProofDefinitionsEnd-/
/-ResultDefinitionsEnd-/

/-ResultBegin-/

theorem tverberg_theorem (d r : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (f : Fin ((r - 1) * (d + 1) + 1) → Space d) :
    HasTverbergPartition (r := r) f :=
/-ResultProofBegin-/by
  classical
  -- choose one point from each lifted color by the colorful lemma
  haveI : Nonempty (Fin r) :=
    (Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mp (lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one hr))
  haveI : Nonempty (Fin ((r - 1) * (d + 1) + 1)) :=
    Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mp (by omega)
  have hc : Fintype.card (Fin ((r - 1) * (d + 1) + 1)) =
      Module.finrank ℝ (Tverberg65.LiftSpace r d) + 1 := by
    simp [Tverberg65.LiftSpace]
  have hcolors (j : Fin ((r - 1) * (d + 1) + 1)) :
      (0 : Tverberg65.LiftSpace r d) ∈
        convexHull ℝ (Set.range (fun k : Fin r => Tverberg65.liftPt hr f j k)) :=
    Tverberg65.zero_in_lift_color hr f j
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := Tverberg65.colorful_zero
    (V := Tverberg65.LiftSpace r d)
    (ι := Fin ((r - 1) * (d + 1) + 1)) (κ := Fin r)
    (fun j k => Tverberg65.liftPt hr f j k) hc hcolors
  exact Tverberg65.lift_zero_gives_partition hr f g hg
/-ResultProofEnd-/
/-ResultEnd-/

import Mathlib
namespace Submission

/-ResultDefinitionsBegin-/
/-ResultProofDefinitionsBegin-/

open scoped Topology InnerProductSpace ComplexConjugate
open Set
noncomputable section

variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- The cyclic (algebraic) subspace generated by one vector by a star algebra. -/
private def vnOrbit (S : StarSubalgebra ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H)) (x : H) : Submodule ℂ H where
  carrier := {y | ∃ A : S, (A : H →L[ℂ] H) x = y}
  zero_mem' := ⟨0, by simp⟩
  add_mem' := by
    intro u v hu hv
    rcases hu with ⟨a, rfl⟩
    rcases hv with ⟨b, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨a+b, by simp⟩
  smul_mem' := by
    intro c u hu
    rcases hu with ⟨a, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨c • a, by simp⟩

private lemma vnOrbit_mem (S : StarSubalgebra ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H)) (x : H)
    (A : S) : (A : H →L[ℂ] H) x ∈ vnOrbit S x :=
  ⟨A, rfl⟩

/-- A closed invariant subspace projection commutes with an operator whose adjoint preserves it. -/
private lemma vn_commute_projection
    (K : Submodule ℂ H) [K.HasOrthogonalProjection]
    (A B : H →L[ℂ] H) (hstar : star A = B)
    (hA : ∀ v ∈ K, A v ∈ K) (hB : ∀ v ∈ K, B v ∈ K) :
    A * K.starProjection = K.starProjection * A := by
  -- projection uniqueness, since both the subspace and its orthogonal complement are invariant
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro v
  -- show P (A v) = A (P v)
  have hmem : A (K.starProjection v) ∈ K := hA _ (K.starProjection_apply_mem v)
  have hperp : A v - A (K.starProjection v) ∈ Kᗮ := by
    rw [K.mem_orthogonal']
    intro u hu
    have huB : B u ∈ K := hB _ hu
    have hvperp : v - K.starProjection v ∈ Kᗮ := K.sub_starProjection_mem_orthogonal v
    have hvzero : ⟪v - K.starProjection v, B u⟫_ℂ = 0 :=
      (K.mem_orthogonal' _).1 hvperp _ huB
    -- move A using its adjoint
    have hadj : ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint A = B := by
      rw [← ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint]
      exact hstar
    -- inner convention is linear on the second argument in mathlib
    -- adjoint_inner_right: <x,A* y> = <A x,y>
    have hh := ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_right A (v - K.starProjection v) u
    rw [hadj] at hh
    -- linearity of A
    have hlin : A v - A (K.starProjection v) = A (v - K.starProjection v) := by simp
    rw [hlin]
    exact hh.symm.trans hvzero
  have hp := K.eq_starProjection_of_mem_orthogonal hmem hperp
  -- target equality is A(Pv)=P(Av)
  simpa [ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply] using hp.symm

/-- The one-vector part of the double commutant approximation argument. -/
private lemma vn_one_vector
    (S : StarSubalgebra ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H))
    {T : H →L[ℂ] H}
    (hT : T ∈ Set.centralizer (Set.centralizer (S : Set (H →L[ℂ] H))))
    (x : H) : T x ∈ (vnOrbit S x).topologicalClosure := by
  let U : Submodule ℂ H := vnOrbit S x
  let K : Submodule ℂ H := U.topologicalClosure
  have hKclosed : IsClosed (K : Set H) := by
    dsimp [K]
    exact Submodule.isClosed_topologicalClosure _
  letI : IsClosed (K : Set H) := hKclosed
  letI : CompleteSpace K := IsClosed.completeSpace_coe
  letI : K.HasOrthogonalProjection := Submodule.HasOrthogonalProjection.ofCompleteSpace K
  -- every element of S preserves the closed cyclic subspace
  have inv (a : S) : ∀ z ∈ K, (a : H →L[ℂ] H) z ∈ K := by
    -- use the closed inverse image
    let L : Submodule ℂ H := K.comap ((a : H →L[ℂ] H) : H →ₗ[ℂ] H)
    have hLclosed : IsClosed (L : Set H) := by
      change IsClosed ((fun y : H => (a : H →L[ℂ] H) y) ⁻¹' (K : Set H))
      exact IsClosed.preimage (a : H →L[ℂ] H).continuous hKclosed
    have hUL : U ≤ L := by
      intro z hz
      rcases hz with ⟨b, rfl⟩
      -- closure target contains the orbit
      change ((a : H →L[ℂ] H) ((b : H →L[ℂ] H) x)) ∈ K
      have hm : (((a*b : S) : H →L[ℂ] H) x) ∈ U := vnOrbit_mem S x (a*b)
      have hmK : (((a*b : S) : H →L[ℂ] H) x) ∈ K :=
        (Submodule.le_topologicalClosure _ hm)
      simpa [ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply] using hmK
    have hKL : K ≤ L := by
      exact Submodule.topologicalClosure_minimal _ hUL hLclosed
    intro z hz
    exact hKL hz
  have hcomm (a : S) :
      (a : H →L[ℂ] H) * K.starProjection = K.starProjection * (a : H →L[ℂ] H) := by
    let ast : S := star a
    have hstar : star (a : H →L[ℂ] H) = (ast : H →L[ℂ] H) := rfl
    exact vn_commute_projection K (a : H →L[ℂ] H) (ast : H →L[ℂ] H)
      hstar (inv a) (inv ast)
  have hPc : K.starProjection ∈ Set.centralizer (S : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) := by
    intro a ha
    -- centralizer definition is forall s in S, commute s? inspect orientation
    have hc := hcomm (⟨a, ha⟩ : S)
    exact hc
  have htc := hT K.starProjection hPc
  -- htc : ? commute ... orientation
  have hxU : x ∈ U := by
    have := vnOrbit_mem S x (1 : S)
    simpa using this
  have hxK : x ∈ K := Submodule.le_topologicalClosure _ hxU
  have hpx : K.starProjection x = x := (K.starProjection_eq_self_iff).2 hxK
  have htxK : T x ∈ K := by
    apply (K.starProjection_eq_self_iff).1
    -- use commutation
    -- htc is T? establish application equality
    have hh := congrArg (fun (L : H →L[ℂ] H) => L x) htc
    -- should be P*T =? by Set.centralizer
    simpa [ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply, hpx] using hh
  exact htxK


section Amp
variable {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
local notation "HH" => PiLp 2 (fun _ : ι => H)

private noncomputable def vnDiag (A : H →L[ℂ] H) : HH →L[ℂ] HH :=
  (PiLp.continuousLinearEquiv 2 ℂ (fun _ : ι => H)).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.comp
    (ContinuousLinearMap.pi (fun i : ι => A.comp (PiLp.proj 2 (fun _ : ι => H) i)))

@[simp] private lemma vnDiag_apply (A : H →L[ℂ] H) (z : HH) (i : ι) :
    (vnDiag (ι:=ι) A z : HH).ofLp i = A (z.ofLp i) := rfl

private lemma vnDiag_mul (A B : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    vnDiag (ι:=ι) (A * B) = vnDiag A * vnDiag B := by
  ext z i
  rfl

private lemma vnDiag_one : vnDiag (H:=H) (ι:=ι) (1 : H →L[ℂ] H) = 1 := by
  ext z i; rfl

private lemma vnDiag_add (A B : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    vnDiag (ι:=ι) (A+B) = vnDiag A + vnDiag B := by ext z i; rfl
private lemma vnDiag_smul (c : ℂ) (A : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    vnDiag (ι:=ι) (c • A) = c • vnDiag A := by ext z i; rfl

private lemma vnDiag_star (A : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    star (vnDiag (ι:=ι) A) = vnDiag (star A) := by
  classical
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint]
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro z
  apply ext_inner_left ℂ
  intro w
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_right]
  simp only [PiLp.inner_apply, vnDiag_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint,
    ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_right]



private noncomputable def vnEmb [DecidableEq ι] (j : ι) : H →L[ℂ] HH :=
  (PiLp.continuousLinearEquiv 2 ℂ (fun _ : ι => H)).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.comp
    (ContinuousLinearMap.single ℂ (fun _ : ι => H) j)

@[simp] private lemma vnEmb_apply [DecidableEq ι] (j i : ι) (v : H) :
    (vnEmb (H:=H) (ι:=ι) j v : HH).ofLp i = (Pi.single j v : ι → H) i := rfl

@[simp] private lemma vnDiag_emb [DecidableEq ι] (A : H →L[ℂ] H) (j : ι) (v : H) :
    vnDiag (ι:=ι) A (vnEmb (H:=H) (ι:=ι) j v) = vnEmb (ι:=ι) j (A v) := by
  apply (PiLp.continuousLinearEquiv 2 ℂ (fun _ : ι => H)).injective
  funext i
  classical
  by_cases h : i = j <;> simp [vnDiag_apply, vnEmb_apply, Pi.single_apply, h]


private noncomputable def vnCoeff [DecidableEq ι]
    (Q : HH →L[ℂ] HH) (i j : ι) : H →L[ℂ] H :=
  (PiLp.proj 2 (fun _ : ι => H) i).comp (Q.comp (vnEmb (H:=H) (ι:=ι) j))

@[simp] private lemma vnCoeff_apply [DecidableEq ι]
    (Q : HH →L[ℂ] HH) (i j : ι) (v : H) :
    vnCoeff Q i j v = (Q (vnEmb (H:=H) (ι:=ι) j v) : HH).ofLp i := rfl

private noncomputable def vnAmpAlg (S : StarSubalgebra ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H)) :
    StarSubalgebra ℂ (HH →L[ℂ] HH) where
  carrier := vnDiag (ι:=ι) '' (S : Set (H →L[ℂ] H))
  mul_mem' := by
    rintro _ _ ⟨a,ha,rfl⟩ ⟨b,hb,rfl⟩
    exact ⟨a*b, S.mul_mem ha hb, (vnDiag_mul _ _).symm⟩
  add_mem' := by
    rintro _ _ ⟨a,ha,rfl⟩ ⟨b,hb,rfl⟩
    exact ⟨a+b, S.add_mem ha hb, (vnDiag_add _ _).symm⟩
  algebraMap_mem' := by
    intro r
    refine ⟨algebraMap ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H) r, S.algebraMap_mem _, ?_⟩
    -- scalar identity; by ext
    ext z i
    rfl
  star_mem' := by
    rintro _ ⟨a,ha,rfl⟩
    exact ⟨star a, S.star_mem' ha, (vnDiag_star _).symm⟩

private lemma vnAmp_double
    (S : StarSubalgebra ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H))
    (T : H →L[ℂ] H)
    (hT : T ∈ Set.centralizer (Set.centralizer (S : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)))) :
    vnDiag (ι:=ι) T ∈ Set.centralizer
       (Set.centralizer (vnAmpAlg (H:=H) (ι:=ι) S : Set (HH →L[ℂ] HH))) := by
  classical
  intro Q hQ
  -- each matrix coefficient of Q commutes with S
  have hc (i j : ι) : vnCoeff (H:=H) Q i j ∈
        Set.centralizer (S : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) := by
    intro a ha
    have hqa : vnDiag (ι:=ι) a * Q = Q * vnDiag a :=
      hQ _ ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro v
    have he := congrArg (fun (L : HH →L[ℂ] HH) =>
      (L (vnEmb (H:=H) (ι:=ι) j v) : HH).ofLp i) hqa
    -- simplifies coordinate; single interacts with diagonal
    -- direct simp then expand single
    simpa [ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply, vnCoeff_apply,
      vnDiag_apply, vnDiag_emb] using he
  -- now T commutes with all coefficients, hence diagonally with Q
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro z
  -- equality in HH, ext coordinates
  apply (PiLp.continuousLinearEquiv 2 ℂ (fun _ : ι => H)).injective
  funext i
  -- prove by expanding z as sum of its single coordinates
  have hz : z = ∑ j : ι, vnEmb (H:=H) (ι:=ι) j (z.ofLp j) := by
    apply (PiLp.continuousLinearEquiv 2 ℂ (fun _ : ι => H)).injective
    funext k
    simp [vnEmb_apply, Pi.single_apply]
  -- get coefficient commute
  have hci (j : ι) := hT _ (hc i j)
  -- rewrite z and linear maps over sum
  -- target after mul_apply: T (Q z)_i = (Q (Diag T z))_i
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply, vnDiag_apply]
  -- operate with hz on occurrences under Q
  
  rw [hz, map_sum]
  simp only [map_sum]
  simp_rw [Finset.sum_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  have he := congrArg (fun (L : H →L[ℂ] H) => L (z.ofLp j)) (hci j)
  -- simplify multiplication and show RHS diagonal T on single
  simpa [ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply, vnCoeff_apply, vnDiag_apply,
    vnEmb_apply, Pi.single_apply, mul_ite, apply_ite] using he


/-- Simultaneous cyclic approximation, on a finite Hilbert sum. The same element of the
 algebra is used in every component. -/
private lemma vn_finite_vector
    (S : StarSubalgebra ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H)) (T : H →L[ℂ] H)
    (hT : T ∈ Set.centralizer (Set.centralizer (S : Set (H →L[ℂ] H))))
    (z : HH) :
    vnDiag (ι:=ι) T z ∈
      (vnOrbit (vnAmpAlg (H:=H) (ι:=ι) S) z).topologicalClosure := by
  exact vn_one_vector (vnAmpAlg (H:=H) (ι:=ι) S)
    (vnAmp_double (ι:=ι) S T hT) z


end Amp



-- The finite-vector argument says exactly that every element of the double
-- commutant is in the strong-operator closure.  We spell this out using the
-- description of the pointwise topology as the subspace of a product.
private lemma vn_mem_sot_closure
    {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    (S : StarSubalgebra ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H)) (T : H →L[ℂ] H)
    (hT : T ∈ Set.centralizer (Set.centralizer (S : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)))) :
    ContinuousLinearMap.toPointwiseConvergenceCLM ℂ (RingHom.id ℂ) H H T ∈
      closure
        (ContinuousLinearMap.toPointwiseConvergenceCLM ℂ (RingHom.id ℂ) H H ''
          (S : Set (H →L[ℂ] H))) := by
  classical
  let fT : PointwiseConvergenceCLM (RingHom.id ℂ) H H :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.toPointwiseConvergenceCLM ℂ (RingHom.id ℂ) H H T
  change fT ∈ closure _
  -- It suffices to meet every neighbourhood.  Coercing to functions identifies
  -- these neighbourhoods with product neighbourhoods.
  refine mem_closure_iff_nhds.mpr ?_
  intro U hU
  have hemb :=
    PointwiseConvergenceCLM.isEmbedding_coeFn (RingHom.id ℂ) H H
  have hU' : U ∈
      Filter.comap
        ((↑) : PointwiseConvergenceCLM (RingHom.id ℂ) H H → (H → H))
        (𝓝 ((fT : PointwiseConvergenceCLM (RingHom.id ℂ) H H) : H → H)) := by
    rw [← hemb.isInducing.nhds_eq_comap fT]
    exact hU
  rcases (Filter.mem_comap.1 hU') with ⟨V, hV, hVU⟩
  rw [nhds_pi] at hV
  rcases (Filter.mem_pi.1 hV) with ⟨I, hIfin, t, ht, htV⟩
  -- use the finite type of the selected vectors
  let ι := {x : H // x ∈ I}
  letI : Fintype ι := hIfin.fintype
  let z : PiLp 2 (fun _ : ι => H) :=
    (PiLp.continuousLinearEquiv 2 ℂ (fun _ : ι => H)).symm
      (fun i : ι => (i.1 : H))
  let y : PiLp 2 (fun _ : ι => H) := vnDiag (ι:=ι) T z
  have hy : y ∈
      (vnOrbit (vnAmpAlg (H:=H) (ι:=ι) S) z).topologicalClosure := by
    exact vn_finite_vector (ι:=ι) S T hT z
  have hy' : y ∈
      closure (vnOrbit (vnAmpAlg (H:=H) (ι:=ι) S) z :
        Set (PiLp 2 (fun _ : ι => H))) := by
    rw [← Submodule.topologicalClosure_coe]
    exact hy
  -- A neighbourhood of `y` saying its finitely many coordinates lie in `t`.
  let W : Set (PiLp 2 (fun _ : ι => H)) :=
    {w | ∀ i : ι, w.ofLp i ∈ t (i.1 : H)}
  have hzcoord (i : ι) : z.ofLp i = (i.1 : H) := by
    rfl
  have hycoord (i : ι) : y.ofLp i = T (i.1 : H) := by
    change (vnDiag (ι:=ι) T z : PiLp 2 (fun _ : ι => H)).ofLp i = _
    rw [vnDiag_apply]
    rfl
  have hW : W ∈ 𝓝 y := by
    have hWei : (⋂ i : ι,
        (fun w : PiLp 2 (fun _ : ι => H) => w.ofLp i) ⁻¹' t (i.1 : H)) ∈
        𝓝 y := by
      rw [Filter.iInter_mem]
      intro i
      have hti : t (i.1 : H) ∈ 𝓝 (T (i.1 : H)) := ht _
      have hti' : t (i.1 : H) ∈
          𝓝 ((fun w : PiLp 2 (fun _ : ι => H) => w.ofLp i) y) := by
        simpa [hycoord i] using hti
      have hc : ContinuousAt
          (fun w : PiLp 2 (fun _ : ι => H) => w.ofLp i) y :=
        (PiLp.proj (𝕜:=ℂ) 2 (fun _ : ι => H) i).continuous.continuousAt
      exact hc.preimage_mem_nhds hti'
    refine Filter.mem_of_superset hWei ?_
    intro w hw
    change ∀ i : ι, w.ofLp i ∈ t (i.1 : H)
    intro i
    exact Set.mem_iInter.mp hw i
  rcases (mem_closure_iff_nhds.mp hy') W hW with ⟨w, hwW, hworb⟩
  -- the vector in the orbit is obtained from one single element of S
  rcases hworb with ⟨A, hAw⟩
  rcases A.property with ⟨a, ha, haa⟩
  have hwform : w = vnDiag (ι:=ι) a z := by
    have hAz : (A : (PiLp 2 (fun _ : ι => H) →L[ℂ]
      PiLp 2 (fun _ : ι => H))) z = w := hAw
    simpa [haa] using hAz.symm
  -- Its non-amplified operator lies in the prescribed product neighbourhood.
  let fa : PointwiseConvergenceCLM (RingHom.id ℂ) H H :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.toPointwiseConvergenceCLM ℂ (RingHom.id ℂ) H H a
  have hpi : (fa : H → H) ∈ I.pi t := by
    intro x hx
    let i : ι := ⟨x, hx⟩
    have hi := hwW i
    change w.ofLp i ∈ t (i.1 : H) at hi
    have hz' : z.ofLp i = x := by rfl
    have hw' : w.ofLp i = a x := by
      rw [hwform, vnDiag_apply]
      rw [hz']
    -- evaluate `fa` definitionally
    change a x ∈ t x
    have hi' : w.ofLp i ∈ t x := by
      simpa [i] using hi
    rw [hw'] at hi'
    exact hi'
  have hfaV : (fa : H → H) ∈ V := htV hpi
  have hfaU : fa ∈ U := hVU hfaV
  have hfaS : fa ∈
      (ContinuousLinearMap.toPointwiseConvergenceCLM ℂ (RingHom.id ℂ) H H ''
        (S : Set (H →L[ℂ] H))) :=
    ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨fa, hfaU, hfaS⟩

private lemma vn_sot_closed_imp_double
    {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    (S : StarSubalgebra ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H))
    (hS : IsClosed
      (ContinuousLinearMap.toPointwiseConvergenceCLM ℂ (RingHom.id ℂ) H H ''
        (S : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)))) :
    Set.centralizer (Set.centralizer (S : Set (H →L[ℂ] H))) = S := by
  classical
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · intro T hT
    have hc := vn_mem_sot_closure S T hT
    have hh :
        ContinuousLinearMap.toPointwiseConvergenceCLM ℂ (RingHom.id ℂ) H H T ∈
          (ContinuousLinearMap.toPointwiseConvergenceCLM ℂ (RingHom.id ℂ) H H ''
            (S : Set (H →L[ℂ] H))) := hS.closure_subset hc
    rcases hh with ⟨a, ha, haT⟩
    have eqn : a = T := by
      apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
      intro x
      have h := congrArg
        (fun f : PointwiseConvergenceCLM (RingHom.id ℂ) H H => f x) haT
      exact h
    rw [← eqn]
    exact ha
  · exact Set.subset_centralizer_centralizer


-- Commuting with fixed operators is a collection of closed conditions in the
-- weak operator topology.
private lemma vn_wot_double_closed
    {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    (S : StarSubalgebra ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H)) :
    IsClosed (ContinuousLinearMapWOT.ofCLM ''
      (Set.centralizer (Set.centralizer (S : Set (H →L[ℂ] H))))) := by
  classical
  let C : Set (H →WOT[ℂ] H) :=
    ⋂ b ∈ Set.centralizer (S : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)), ⋂ x : H, ⋂ y : H,
      {A : H →WOT[ℂ] H | ⟪y, b (A x)⟫_ℂ = ⟪y, A (b x)⟫_ℂ}
  have hcell (b : H →L[ℂ] H) (x y : H) :
      IsClosed {A : H →WOT[ℂ] H |
        ⟪y, b (A x)⟫_ℂ = ⟪y, A (b x)⟫_ℂ} := by
    have hf0 : Continuous
        (fun A : H →WOT[ℂ] H =>
          ⟪(ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint b) y, A x⟫_ℂ) :=
      ContinuousLinearMapWOT.continuous_inner_apply
        (f := fun A : H →WOT[ℂ] H => A) continuous_id x
          ((ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint b) y)
    have hf : Continuous
        (fun A : H →WOT[ℂ] H => ⟪y, b (A x)⟫_ℂ) := by
      simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left] using hf0
    have hg : Continuous
        (fun A : H →WOT[ℂ] H => ⟪y, A (b x)⟫_ℂ) :=
      ContinuousLinearMapWOT.continuous_inner_apply
        (f := fun A : H →WOT[ℂ] H => A) continuous_id (b x) y
    exact isClosed_eq hf hg
  have hC : IsClosed C := by
    dsimp [C]
    refine isClosed_biInter ?_
    intro b hb
    refine isClosed_iInter (fun x => ?_)
    refine isClosed_iInter (fun y => ?_)
    exact hcell b x y
  have heq :
      (ContinuousLinearMapWOT.ofCLM ''
        (Set.centralizer (Set.centralizer (S : Set (H →L[ℂ] H))))) = C := by
    ext A
    constructor
    · intro hA
      rcases hA with ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
      -- commuting equality, tested against arbitrary matrix coefficients
      change ContinuousLinearMapWOT.ofCLM a ∈ C
      -- unfold the intersections
      simp only [C, Set.mem_iInter, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
      intro b hb x y
      have hba := ha b hb
      have hv := congrArg (fun (L : H →L[ℂ] H) => L x) hba
      have hv' : b (a x) = a (b x) := by
        simpa [ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply] using hv
      simpa using congrArg (fun v : H => ⟪y, v⟫_ℂ) hv'
    · intro hA
      have hprop : ∀ b : H →L[ℂ] H,
          b ∈ Set.centralizer (S : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) →
          ∀ x y : H, ⟪y, b (A x)⟫_ℂ = ⟪y, A (b x)⟫_ℂ := by
        simpa only [C, Set.mem_iInter, Set.mem_setOf_eq] using hA
      let a : H →L[ℂ] H := ContinuousLinearMapWOT.toCLM A
      have ha : a ∈ Set.centralizer
          (Set.centralizer (S : Set (H →L[ℂ] H))) := by
        intro b hb
        apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
        intro x
        apply ext_inner_left ℂ
        intro y
        have hv := hprop b hb x y
        simpa [a, ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply] using hv
      refine ⟨a, ha, ?_⟩
      -- the two directions between the type copies are inverse
      apply ContinuousLinearMapWOT.ext_inner
      intro x y
      rfl
  rw [heq]
  exact hC

private lemma vn_double_imp_wot_closed
    {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    (S : StarSubalgebra ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H))
    (hS : Set.centralizer (Set.centralizer (S : Set (H →L[ℂ] H))) = S) :
    IsClosed (ContinuousLinearMapWOT.ofCLM '' (S : Set (H →L[ℂ] H))) := by
  have h := vn_wot_double_closed S
  rw [hS] at h
  exact h


private lemma vn_wot_closed_imp_sot_closed
    {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    (S : StarSubalgebra ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H))
    (hS : IsClosed (ContinuousLinearMapWOT.ofCLM ''
      (S : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)))) :
    IsClosed
      (ContinuousLinearMap.toPointwiseConvergenceCLM ℂ (RingHom.id ℂ) H H ''
        (S : Set (H →L[ℂ] H))) := by
  let g := fun A : PointwiseConvergenceCLM (RingHom.id ℂ) H H =>
      ContinuousLinearMapWOT.ofCLM A
  have hg : Continuous g := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMapWOT.continuous
    intro x y
    have hx : Continuous (fun A : PointwiseConvergenceCLM (RingHom.id ℂ) H H => A x) :=
      (PointwiseConvergenceCLM.evalCLM (RingHom.id ℂ) H x).continuous
    have hp : Continuous (fun A : PointwiseConvergenceCLM (RingHom.id ℂ) H H =>
        ((y, A x) : H × H)) := by
      have hh : Continuous
          (fun _ : PointwiseConvergenceCLM (RingHom.id ℂ) H H => y) :=
        continuous_const
      exact Continuous.prodMk hh hx
    have hc : Continuous
        (fun A : PointwiseConvergenceCLM (RingHom.id ℂ) H H => ⟪y, A x⟫_ℂ) :=
      (continuous_inner (𝕜:=ℂ) (E:=H)).comp hp
    change Continuous
      (fun A : PointwiseConvergenceCLM (RingHom.id ℂ) H H => ⟪y, A x⟫_ℂ)
    exact hc
  have hp := hS.preimage hg
  have heq :
      g ⁻¹' (ContinuousLinearMapWOT.ofCLM ''
          (S : Set (H →L[ℂ] H))) =
        (ContinuousLinearMap.toPointwiseConvergenceCLM ℂ (RingHom.id ℂ) H H ''
          (S : Set (H →L[ℂ] H))) := by
    ext A
    constructor
    · intro hA
      rcases hA with ⟨a, ha, haA⟩
      have hAx : ∀ x : H, A x = a x := by
        intro x
        have hh : (g A) x = (ContinuousLinearMapWOT.ofCLM a) x :=
          congrArg (fun u : H →WOT[ℂ] H => u x) haA.symm
        exact hh
      refine ⟨a, ha, ?_⟩
      apply UniformConvergenceCLM.ext (RingHom.id ℂ) H
      intro x
      exact (hAx x).symm
    · intro hA
      rcases hA with ⟨a, ha, haA⟩
      change g A ∈ (ContinuousLinearMapWOT.ofCLM ''
          (S : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)))
      refine ⟨a, ha, ?_⟩
      -- pointwise equality is enough on the WOT copy as well
      apply ContinuousLinearMapWOT.ext_inner
      intro x y
      have hx := congrArg
        (fun u : PointwiseConvergenceCLM (RingHom.id ℂ) H H => u x)
          haA
      -- `haA` says the strong copy of `a` is `A`
      -- and the two coercions have the same evaluations
      change ⟪y, a x⟫_ℂ = ⟪y, A x⟫_ℂ
      exact congrArg (fun v : H => ⟪y, v⟫_ℂ) hx
  rw [← heq]
  exact hp

end -- noncomputable section for helpers

/-ResultProofDefinitionsEnd-/
/-ResultDefinitionsEnd-/

/-ResultBegin-/

theorem vonNeumann_doubleCommutant_tfae {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    (S : StarSubalgebra ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H)) :
    List.TFAE
      [ Set.centralizer (Set.centralizer (S : Set (H →L[ℂ] H))) = S
      , IsClosed
          (ContinuousLinearMapWOT.ofCLM '' (S : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)))
      , IsClosed
          (ContinuousLinearMap.toPointwiseConvergenceCLM ℂ (RingHom.id ℂ) H H ''
            (S : Set (H →L[ℂ] H))) ] :=
/-ResultProofBegin-/by
  -- go round the natural three implications
  -- double commutant -> WOT closed -> SOT closed -> double commutant
  simp only [List.tfae_cons_cons, List.tfae_singleton]
  constructor
  · constructor
    · exact fun h => vn_double_imp_wot_closed S h
    · intro hw
      exact vn_sot_closed_imp_double S (vn_wot_closed_imp_sot_closed S hw)
  · constructor
    · constructor
      · exact fun h => vn_wot_closed_imp_sot_closed S h
      · intro hs
        have hd := vn_sot_closed_imp_double S hs
        exact vn_double_imp_wot_closed S hd
    · trivial
/-ResultProofEnd-/
/-ResultEnd-/

end Submission
